findings.body: The change updates the usage lines in README.md and CLAUDE.md to "pull + restart, then prune dangling images". The script's own header was not updated: `# Rebuild Docker Services (pull + restart)`. Someone who reads the script, or runs it directly on the server, gets no hint that every run, including one where a service failed, now deletes dangling images host-wide, not just for the services named.
findings.fix: Change the header to `# Rebuild Docker Services (pull + restart, then prune dangling images)`.

findings.title: No test covers a failed service and a failed prune in the same run, so a prune failure that masks a service failure would pass
findings.body: The goal requires that a prune failure "leaves the exit status as the services set it". `test_docker_rebuild_warns_when_pruning_fails_without_failing_the_run` only checks the case where every service succeeds and expects exit 0. `test_docker_rebuild_prunes_after_a_failed_service_without_masking_its_status` only checks a prune that succeeds. Consider an implementation whose prune-failure branch ends the script with success, e.g. `|| { log_warn ...; exit 0; }`, or one that sets the final status from the prune result. It would pass all three tests while reporting success for a run where service `b` failed to pull. `ship.sh` and the operator would then see a green rebuild.
findings.fix: Add a case with `FAKE_DOCKER_FAIL_PULL_SERVICE=b` and `FAKE_DOCKER_FAIL_PRUNE=1` that asserts exit status 1, exactly one `image prune -f` line, and the `[!]` warning.

findings.title: Очистка не гарантирует сохранение локального образа для отката
findings.body: Новое утверждение «локальная копия для отката остаётся» противоречит работе rebuild.sh. При обновлении изменяемого тега pull переносит тег на новый образ, а down удаляет контейнер со старым образом. Если других ссылок нет, старый образ становится dangling, и docker image prune -f удаляет его. Оператору обещан локальный откат, для которого образ уже может отсутствовать.
findings.fix: Убрать обещание сохранения образа для отката и указать, что старые образы без тегов и контейнеров удаляются.

findings.title: Journald cap only applies through a full bootstrap.sh run, whose set_permissions must not be rerun on the populated host
findings.body: `configure_journald` is called only from bootstrap.sh `main()`. There is no standalone entry point or argument to run it alone. `main()` also runs `set_permissions`, which does recursive `chown -R` and `chmod -R` over appdata, `$DATA_PATH/public`, users and backups. The project already documents this as irreversible on a populated tree (ENVIRONMENT.md:176, the RAID1 migration plan KTD6; ENVIRONMENT.md:163 says to restart smartd by hand rather than rerun bootstrap.sh). The function itself is idempotent, but the docs (ENVIRONMENT.md:138, CLAUDE.md:70) give no safe way to apply it on the existing server. So either the cap never reaches the live host, or the operator reruns bootstrap and rewrites ownership and modes across appdata and the RAID tree.
findings.fix: Move configure_journald into its own setup step (e.g. scripts/setup/NN-configure-journald.sh sourcing config.sh), or let bootstrap.sh run a single step by argument. Document that command, not a bootstrap rerun, in ENVIRONMENT.md and CLAUDE.md.

findings.title: Doc claims the rollback copy survives prune, but the previous version of a re-pulled tag is exactly the dangling image pruned
findings.body: ENVIRONMENT.md:139 says only dangling images are removed and 'локальная копия для отката остаются'. In rebuild.sh, `docker compose pull` re-tags `:latest`/`:stable` etc. to the new image; the previous image loses its tag, and after `down` removes the container using it, it is dangling and unreferenced, so the new `docker image prune -f` (rebuild.sh:33) deletes it. This also happens for a failed service: if pull and down succeed but `up -d` fails (_lib.sh:272-274), the last working image is deleted, and recovering means a registry re-pull that may not be addressable for a floating tag. The behaviour is what the goal asks for; the documentation of what remains is wrong, and ENVIRONMENT.md is the reference consulted before server work.
findings.fix: Reword: prune removes the previous version of every rebuilt image; to keep a rollback copy, tag it before rebuilding or pin by digest.

findings.title: Disk-space alerts are lost if HA restarts/reloads while usage is already above the threshold but before the 10-minute alert has fired
findings.body: HA's numeric_state trigger only arms an entity whose value is below the threshold when the trigger attaches. A restart or automation reload cancels a pending `for:` timer. If that happens after usage has crossed 85% (SSD) or 90% (RAID) but before the 10-minute alert has fired, or if usage crosses the threshold while HA is down (for example during a homeassistant rebuild), the trigger stays disarmed. No push arrives until usage drops below the threshold and crosses it again. For a slowly filling disk that may never happen. The window is narrow, and every existing numeric_state alert in hardware_health.yaml has the same behaviour. The file already notes this transition-only pitfall for server_glances_autoreload. So this is a real but low-probability gap, not a major defect.
findings.fix: Add a `homeassistant: start` trigger (or the same `time_pattern` approach server_glances_autoreload uses) with a numeric_state condition `above: 85` / `above: 90`. That way a threshold that is already exceeded still produces a push.

findings.title: Документация ошибочно обещает сохранение локального образа для отката
findings.body: При обновлении изменяемого тега, например homeassistant:stable, pull переносит тег на новый образ, а down удаляет контейнер со ссылкой на старый. Если других тегов и контейнеров нет, старый образ становится dangling и добавленный prune удаляет его. Поэтому локальная копия для отката не гарантирована, вопреки новой строке документации. Условия удаления подтверждает [документация Docker](https://docs.docker.com/engine/manage-resources/pruning/).
findings.fix: Убрать обещание сохранения копии для отката и указать, что предыдущий образ может быть удалён.

findings.title: configure_network re-sources config.sh that bootstrap now sources at top level
findings.body: The change adds `source "$PROJECT_DIR/scripts/lib/config.sh"` at scripts/bootstrap.sh:66 (needed for JOURNALD_SYSTEM_MAX_USE). That load already supplies NET_IP, NET_INTERFACE_MATCH, NET_GATEWAY, NET_DNS_PRIMARY and NET_DNS_FALLBACK for configure_network. The second load at line 197 inside configure_network is now redundant. It leaves two load points for the same configuration, and a reader has to check whether the second one is there to override something. It is not: config.sh only exports fixed values, and `USER=${USER:-...}` is idempotent. Nothing between line 66 and the call to configure_network in main changes these variables.
findings.fix: Delete the `source "$PROJECT_DIR/scripts/lib/config.sh"` line inside configure_network (scripts/bootstrap.sh:197). The top-level load at line 66 already provides the same values.

findings.title: ENVIRONMENT.md says the local rollback image survives the prune, but the prune deletes it
findings.body: Line 139 says: "Удаляются только dangling images; образы остановленных сервисов и локальная копия для отката остаются." `do_rebuild` (`scripts/docker/_lib.sh:272-274`) runs `pull`, then `down`, then `up -d`. Almost every service uses a moving tag (`latest`, `stable`, `latest-full`, ...). The pull moves the tag to the new image, so the old image becomes `<none>:<none>`. Once `down`/`up -d` replace the container, nothing references the old image, so the new `docker image prune -f` in `rebuild.sh:33` deletes it. The failure path is affected too: if `down` succeeds and `up -d` fails, the last working image is pruned. After a rebuild there is no local copy to roll back to. ENVIRONMENT.md is agent-facing reference (CLAUDE.md:9), so an agent or operator would treat a rebuild as locally reversible when it is not. The script does what was intended; the defect is in the doc.
findings.fix: Replace the claim, e.g.: «Удаляются только dangling images, включая предыдущую версию образа обновлённого сервиса — локального отката после rebuild нет; образы остановленных сервисов (с тегом) остаются.» Optionally add that a rollback copy needs a tag or digest pin before rebuilding.

findings.title: "use the real rootfs sensors" does not say which entities those are
findings.body: Line 72 says: "use the real rootfs sensors, never `snap_*` sensors". It does not name the entities and does not point to where they are listed. The RAID sensor's id is `sensor.living_room_127_0_0_1_rootfs_mnt_data_disk_usage`, and nobody would derive that from "rootfs". The ids are listed in the header of `services/homeassistant/config/packages/hardware_health.yaml` (lines 13-16). The line also leans on a prohibition (`never snap_*`) where the agent needs a positive target. Agents editing these alerts or the dashboard would each have to work out the sensors on their own.
findings.fix: Replace it with: "Sensor ids: header of `services/homeassistant/config/packages/hardware_health.yaml` (`sensor.127_0_0_1_rootfs_disk_usage`, `sensor.living_room_127_0_0_1_rootfs_mnt_data_disk_usage`)."

findings.title: Prune behaviour is stated in two places, and the guardrail is reachable only through the disk-space trigger
findings.body: Line 61 (the deploy/rebuild block) and line 71 (the new disk-space block) both describe the prune: "pull + restart, then prune dangling images" and "`rebuild.sh` prunes dangling Docker images after all requested services…". That is one meaning in two places. The guardrail "It never uses `docker image prune -a`" sits only in the block triggered by "disk space, journald, or Home Assistant hardware alerts". An agent editing `rebuild.sh` fires the rebuild block, where the guardrail is missing, so whether it sees it depends on the wording of its task. The guardrail is also phrased as a description of the code rather than as the target ("prune only dangling images"). In addition, the new block is in English inside an otherwise Russian CLAUDE.md.
findings.fix: Keep the prune rule in a single place, the rebuild block's comment or one bullet next to it, phrased positively ("prune only dangling images: `docker image prune -f`"). Drop line 71, or reduce it to a pointer.

findings.title: «Изменить» focuses the format trigger before scrolling, so the smooth (reduced-motion-aware) scroll never plays
findings.body: The summary bar's «Изменить» handler calls `firstField?.focus()` with no `preventScroll`, then calls `header.scrollIntoView({ behavior: shouldAnimate ? 'smooth' : 'auto' })`. The header is always off-screen at that moment, because that is the only time the bar is visible. A plain `focus()` scrolls the focused element into view instantly, so the page jumps to the Формат trigger in one step. The smooth `scrollIntoView` then only moves the last few pixels to the card's scroll margin. The `matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference)')` check therefore does nothing: users who allow motion never get the animated return. Final position and focus are correct, and the e2e test checks only those, so it can't catch this.
findings.fix: Call `firstField?.focus({ preventScroll: true })` so the explicit `scrollIntoView` controls the motion, or focus after the scroll.

findings.title: The summary bar's PDF button shows no busy label, status or error; all of that feedback stays in the off-screen card
findings.body:
The bar shows only while the header card is out of view. Its `Скачать PDF` button uses the same `disabled={!canGenerate}` and calls the same `download()` as the card's button. But all feedback for that action is rendered inside the off-screen `.minis-header-pdf`: `draftError`, the preparing/busy status («Обрабатываем изображения», «Создаём PDF…»), `message` (set by `store.reportPdfFailure()`) and the busy label «Подготовка PDF…». The bar shows only `settingsSummary` and a fixed «Скачать PDF» label and `aria-label`.

Concrete cases:
(1) While images are still preparing, or while a margin/count draft is invalid, a sighted user sees the bar's button disabled with no reason.
(2) Clicking download in the bar keeps the label «Скачать PDF» and shows no progress, while the card's button switches to «Подготовка PDF…».
(3) If generation fails after a click in the bar, the failure message appears only in the off-screen card.

Live regions do announce to screen readers, but sighted users don't see it. Also, `Изменить` focuses the Format select rather than the field that is actually invalid.
findings.fix: Use the card's label on the bar button (`busy ? 'Подготовка PDF…' : 'Скачать PDF'`), and show a short status/error line (`draftError` / busy / preparing / `message`) inside `.minis-summary-content`.

findings.title: The bar-hidden assertion still passes if the bar stays visible
findings.body: If the CSS stops hiding the summary bar while the settings card is visible, the assertions here and at line 328 stay green. The component keeps `aria-hidden=true`, so `getByRole` excludes the «Изменить» button, and `toBeHidden` passes when no element matches. A user would still see a stray fixed bar over the page. So the test has no real guard against a regression in the bar's visibility.
findings.fix: Check visual hiding with `page.locator('.minis-summary-bar')`, which finds the bar regardless of `aria-hidden`, and assert the `aria-hidden` state separately.

findings.title: "Изменить" focuses the select trigger before the smooth scroll, so the reduced-motion/smooth branch never animates
findings.body: The summary bar's edit handler calls `firstField?.focus()` with no options and then `header.scrollIntoView({ behavior: shouldAnimate ? 'smooth' : 'auto' })`. A plain `focus()` scrolls the focused element into view instantly. By the time `scrollIntoView` runs, the page has already jumped to the trigger, so the smooth scroll only nudges the header from "nearest" to "start". The `matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference)')` check therefore does nothing useful for users who allow motion: they still get a jump instead of the animated return the code is written to give. The final position and focus are correct (the e2e test checks both), so the impact stays small.
findings.fix: Call `firstField?.focus({ preventScroll: true })` so the explicit `scrollIntoView` controls the motion.

findings.title: Summary-bar PDF button gives no busy label and shows none of the status or error messages
findings.body: The bar shows only while the header card is out of view. The bar's `Скачать PDF` button is disabled by `canGenerate`, just like the card's button. But all the explanations are rendered inside the off-screen card: `draftError`, `message` (set by `reportPdfFailure`), the "Обрабатываем изображения" preparing status and the busy label "Подготовка PDF…". Two concrete cases: (1) while images are still preparing, or while a margin/count draft is invalid, a sighted user sees a disabled button in the bar with no reason; (2) clicking the bar's download while busy keeps the label "Скачать PDF" and gives no progress text, while the card's button switches to "Подготовка PDF…". The live regions do announce to screen readers, but sighted users only see the change in the card. The goal says the bar's actions should do what the card's do; the action itself matches, but its feedback does not.
findings.fix: Mirror the card's busy label (`busy ? 'Подготовка PDF…' : 'Скачать PDF'`) on the bar button, and show a short status/error line (or at least `draftError`/`message`) in the bar.

findings.title: Accordion primitive is left with no callers after the settings move to a header
findings.body: This change removed the only import of `@/components/ui/accordion` (from PaperMinisGenerator.tsx). A search of `src/` finds no other reference to `ui/accordion`; every other primitive in `src/components/ui/` still has at least one importer. The file is now dead code. Tailwind v4 scans every source file for class names, not just imported ones, so the accordion's utility classes probably still end up in the client CSS that `size-limit` caps at 10 kB. This change also adds about 190 lines of CSS against that same budget.
findings.fix: Delete `src/components/ui/accordion.tsx`, or state that it is intentionally kept for upcoming use.

findings.title: The bar's PDF button shares the card's enabled state, but the reason it is disabled or failed is shown only in the out-of-view card
findings.body:
Observed: the bar's `Скачать PDF` uses `disabled={!canGenerate}` and calls the same `download()` as the card. All of the feedback for that action stays inside `.minis-header-pdf`, which by definition is out of view whenever the bar shows. That feedback is: `draftError`, the `preparing`/`busy` status, `message` (which `store.reportPdfFailure()` sets) and the busy label `Подготовка PDF…`. The bar renders only `settingsSummary` and a fixed `Скачать PDF` label.

Inferred consequence: a user is scrolled down in the minis list and enters an invalid copy count in a row (`rowDraftError`), or images are still processing. The bar's PDF button goes disabled with no visible reason. Likewise, if generation fails after a click in the bar, the failure message appears only in the off-screen card, so a sighted user sees nothing happen. `Изменить` then focuses the Format select, not the field that is actually invalid.

The goal asks that the bar's actions 'do what the card's do'. The action does, but its feedback is not carried over.
findings.fix: Render `draftError` / the busy and preparing status / `message` (or a short version) inside `.minis-summary-content`, and use the same busy label as the card. Alternatively, make `Изменить` focus the invalid field when `draftError` is set.

findings.title: The fixed summary bar covers the top of the viewport and no `scroll-padding-block-start` makes room for it
findings.body:
Observed: `.minis-summary-bar` is `position: fixed; inset-block-start: 0` with a minimum height of about 3.5rem (3rem content plus padding). It shows whenever the header card is out of view. Nothing in the diff adds `scroll-padding-block-start` to the scroll container, and the card's own `scroll-margin-block-start` only helps when the card itself is the scroll target.

Inferred consequence: when a keyboard user Shift+Tabs upward through the minis rows (count inputs, height selects, the `Сменить высоту` menu), the browser scrolls each newly focused control to the top edge of the viewport, behind the bar. The focused control is then hidden (WCAG 2.4.11 Focus Not Obscured). The bar did not exist before; the old sidebar was sticky inside its own column and did not overlay the content.
findings.fix: Add `scroll-padding-block-start` about the bar's height (for example on `html` via a `:has(.minis-summary-bar[data-visible='true'])` rule, or unconditionally on this page), so that focus-driven scrolling stops below the bar.

findings.title: `Изменить` calls `focus()` without `preventScroll` before the reduced-motion-aware `scrollIntoView`
findings.body:
Observed: the handler calls `firstField?.focus()` first, then `header?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: shouldAnimate ? 'smooth' : 'auto' })`. Under the HTML spec, `focus()` without `preventScroll: true` scrolls the element into view with behavior `auto`, which is an instant jump.

Consequence: by the time `scrollIntoView` runs, the page has already jumped to the Format trigger, which sits a few rem below the card's top. The 'smooth' branch only animates that small remaining distance. The `prefers-reduced-motion` check therefore does almost nothing, and users who allow motion get an abrupt jump instead of the intended smooth return. Cosmetic: focus does land correctly, as the e2e test confirms.
findings.fix: Call `firstField?.focus({ preventScroll: true })`, or focus after the scroll.

findings.title: Браузерный сценарий прокручивает страницу без закрытия popover
findings.body: После ввода 97 клавиша Tab переводит фокус на «Сбросить измерение» внутри модального popover. Затем scrollIntoViewIfNeeded программно прокручивает страницу, обходя блокировку пользовательской прокрутки. Сценарий не проверяет закрытие через Escape или внешний клик, возврат фокуса и восстановление неверного значения. Поэтому браузерная проверка останется зелёной при поломке этих действий, хотя goal.md прямо требует их проверки в браузере. Модальность подтверждает [документация React Aria](https://react-aria.adobe.com/Popover).
findings.fix: Перед прокруткой закрыть popover пользовательским действием и проверить закрытие и возврат фокуса. Добавить браузерные случаи с неверным значением 79 для Escape и внешнего клика, проверяя восстановление значения и доступность PDF.

findings.title: The scale popover's className has a dead hook class and repeats the primitive's own defaults
findings.body: The `className` passed to `<Popover>` starts with `minis-scale-popover`, and nothing uses that class: there is no rule in `src/styles/global.css` and no selector in src or tests. The string also adds `rounded-lg`, `shadow-md` and `bg-surface-elevated`. The primitive in `src/components/ui/popover.tsx:37` already applies `rounded-lg` and `shadow-md`, and its `bg-popover` resolves to the same colour (`--color-popover: var(--color-surface-elevated)`). So four of the eight classes change nothing in the rendered popover, and they suggest a CSS hook and a style override that don't exist.
findings.fix: Reduce the className to `w-[min(24rem,calc(100vw-2rem))] border border-border p-4` and drop `minis-scale-popover`.

findings.title: `baseStyleSummary` hand-copies the `baseStyleOptions` labels in lowercase
findings.body: The new `baseStyleSummary` record ('складная', 'плоская', 'на пенокартоне') is exactly the `label` of each entry in `baseStyleOptions` (lines 65-69) passed through `toLowerCase()`. Lowercasing these Cyrillic strings has no locale quirks, so the output is identical. With two tables, a later wording change to a style label has to be made twice. If only `baseStyleOptions` is edited, the summary bar shows stale wording next to a select that reads differently, and the `Record<BaseStyle,string>` type does not catch that mismatch.
findings.fix: Remove `baseStyleSummary` and build the segment from the existing table: `baseStyleOptions.find(({ value }) => value === settings.baseStyle)?.label.toLowerCase()`. The existing `.filter(Boolean)` already drops `undefined`. Alternatively, hoist the label lookup that `SelectValue` already does and reuse it.

findings.title: The scoped range deletes CTA_NAMES/CTA_SECTIONS/ctaAttrs from site.ts instead of adding a `ticket` section
findings.body:
Because base 4bdce06aa7 is not an ancestor of HEAD 6fbfb05e2f, the scoped diff runs backwards relative to the goal. In site.ts it removes `CTA_NAMES`, `CTA_SECTIONS`, `CtaSection`, `ctaAttrs` and `BOOK_CALL_PLACEMENTS`, and drops the `section` parameter and the `data-cta`/`data-cta-section` attributes from `contactEmailHtml`. Both offer pages also lose `data-cta`/`data-cta-section` on the gift ticket, the store block and the blocked-state links, and the `close.primary` entries lose `ctaName`.

A `ticket` section doesn't exist anywhere. Shipping this range would ship none of PRD-3672 and would roll back PRD-3663's ctaClicked naming (#6813).
findings.fix: Point the review at the real PRD-3672 branch, which should descend from 4bdce06aa7, or rebase the change onto 4bdce06aa7. Keep CTA_SECTIONS and ctaAttrs and add `ticket` to CTA_SECTIONS. Do not open the PR from 6fbfb05e2f.

findings.title: В проверяемом HEAD offerAccepted по-прежнему отправляется без section
findings.body: При клике на любую Start-кнопку действующего предложения обработчик отправляет только offerKey и необязательные company и amazonStoreKey. Аналогичный обработчик в amazon-checkup-offer.tsx:504–508 также не добавляет section. Поэтому отличить ticket, hero и close-band в offerAccepted невозможно, вопреки цели PRD-3672. Это поведение уже есть в указанной базе, а не введено рассматриваемой веткой: предоставленный HEAD 6fbfb05e2f содержит изменения предпросмотра партнёра, и diff от общего предка не содержит заявленной реализации PRD-3672.

findings.title: Reviewed revision does not contain the PRD-3672 change; the scoped range would delete CTA_SECTIONS/ctaAttrs instead of adding 'ticket'
findings.body: The scope names branch `prd-3672-offer-page-name` (10 files, offerAccepted gains `section`, CTA_SECTIONS gains `ticket`). The checkout is a detached HEAD 6fbfb05e2f whose own commits (bbc3780d79..6fbfb05e2f) touch only partner-profile preview files. Its merge-base with the stated base 4bdce06aa7 is 79810ee497 (#6709), so base is not an ancestor and `git diff 4bdce06aa7..6fbfb05e2f` spans 1090 files, mostly reverting main's #6710–#6814. Concretely, against the goal's correctness criteria at HEAD: `amazon-scorecard-offer.tsx:490-495` and `amazon-checkup-offer.tsx:~503-508` build `offerAccepted` from offerKey/company/amazonStoreKey only — no `section` is read from `data-cta-section`; and the site.ts hunk removes `CTA_NAMES`, `CTA_SECTIONS`, `CtaSection`, `ctaAttrs` and `BOOK_CALL_PLACEMENTS` and drops `data-cta`/`data-cta-section` from `contactEmailHtml` rather than adding `ticket`. Shipping this range would ship none of PRD-3672 and would roll back the ctaClicked naming from #6813. The supplied "406 tests green / typecheck 0" evidence therefore cannot be for this revision. No grep in the repo history finds a PRD-3672 offer-page commit.
findings.fix: Re-run the review against the actual prd-3672-offer-page-name head with a base that is its merge-base with main (git merge-base main <branch>).

findings.title: The ctaClicked handler is removed from the shared POSTHOG_SCRIPT, so public pages stop sending ctaClicked
findings.body:
The scoped diff removes `ctaClickHandler` and both of its event-listener registrations from the shared POSTHOG_SCRIPT, and it also removes the CTA attributes and CTA_SECTIONS. Autocapture is disabled (`autocapture:false`) and nothing else in the marketing code sends ctaClicked. Once the pages are generated, pressing Start on either offer page no longer sends ctaClicked at all.

This breaks the existing contract in internal-dev-doc/posthog-session-replay.md:23 and the goal's requirement that ctaClicked keep a consistent name and section.
findings.fix: Keep the ctaClicked handler and the CTA attributes. Add `ticket` to CTA_SECTIONS and give the offer buttons the ticket/hero/close-band sections.

findings.title: offerAccepted по-прежнему не содержит section
findings.body: При valid-предложении обработчик любой из трёх кнопок отправляет только offerKey и необязательные company и amazonStoreKey. Секция нажатой кнопки нигде не читается. То же происходит в amazon-checkup-offer.tsx:504–508, поэтому разделить принятия предложения по кнопкам невозможно. Отсутствие section существовало до изменения и осталось в проверяемом HEAD, вопреки явному контракту PRD-3672 в goal.md.
findings.fix: На обеих страницах добавить section из data-cta-section нажатой кнопки в payload offerAccepted и назначить атрибут всем трём кнопкам.

findings.title: Tests expect offerAccepted without `section` and press only the first Start button (wrong revision)
findings.body: At the reviewed HEAD, amazon-scorecard-offer.test.ts:~719-723 and amazon-checkup-offer.test.ts:~472-479 expect an exact offerAccepted payload with no `section`, and only the first Start button is pressed. The only change to these files in the range is a reverted `[^>]*` in the blocked-offer link regexes. That is the same cause as 0b428a125b82a0d4101b022d42bd7ffc: the reviewed revision doesn't contain the PRD-3672 change at all, rather than having a test gap of its own. Once the review runs against the real branch tip, it should check that each of the three buttons asserts its own section (ticket/hero/close-band).
findings.fix: On both pages, test clicks on the ticket, store-block and closing-band buttons and expect section ticket, hero and close-band respectively.

findings.title: The reviewed state doesn't contain the PRD-3672 change: offerAccepted still has no `section` on either offer page
findings.body:
HEAD 6fbfb05e2f ('fix: remove eager partner preview post') does not descend from the scope's base 4bdce06aa7 (PRD-3663/3666 CTA naming, #6813). Their merge base is 79810ee497. HEAD adds four partner-preview commits on top of it, so the scope's `git diff 4bdce06aa7..6fbfb05e2f` spans about 1090 files instead of the 10 the scope describes. The diff mostly reverts main's work.

At HEAD, `press()` in amazon-scorecard-offer.tsx (~486-495) builds `accepted = { offerKey, company?, amazonStoreKey? }` and never reads `data-cta-section`. The matching handler in amazon-checkup-offer.tsx (~503-508) does the same. Every Start button (gift ticket, store block, closing band) therefore sends offerAccepted with no `section`, and PostHog can't tell ticket, hero and close-band apart.

Every 'Correct only if' condition in the PRD-3672 goal fails on this state. The supplied '406 tests green / typecheck 0' evidence can't belong to this revision. No commit mentions PRD-3672, and the branch `prd-3672-offer-page-name` isn't present in the checkout.
findings.fix: Re-run the review against the actual `prd-3672-offer-page-name` tip, diffed against its merge-base with main. On both pages, put `data-cta-section` values ticket/hero/close-band on the three Start buttons and pass the clicked button's value into `accepted.section`.

findings.title: В offerAccepted отсутствует section на обеих страницах
findings.body: При нажатии любой Start-кнопки валидного предложения обработчик отправляет только offerKey и необязательные company и amazonStoreKey. Аналогичный код находится в amazon-checkup-offer.tsx:504–508. Поэтому PostHog не различает ticket, hero и close-band, что нарушает указанный контракт PRD-3672. Отсутствие поля существовало уже в базовом коммите: в фактически заданном диапазоне заявленное исправление отсутствует.
findings.fix: Добавить кнопкам data-cta-section со значениями ticket, hero и close-band и передавать значение нажатой кнопки в accepted.section на обеих страницах.

findings.title: Удалён обработчик отправки ctaClicked
findings.body: Заданный diff удаляет ctaClickHandler и обе регистрации его слушателей из общего POSTHOG_SCRIPT. После генерации страниц нажатие Start на любой из двух offer-страниц больше не отправляет ctaClicked вообще. Автосбор событий отключён через autocapture:false, а другого отправителя ctaClicked в marketing-коде нет. Это новая регрессия заданного диапазона: требуемая согласованность section между событиями заменяется прекращением отправки ctaClicked.
findings.fix: Восстановить обработчик ctaClicked и CTA-атрибуты кнопок, сохранив предусмотренные значения section.

findings.title: The auxclick handler accepts a right mouse click and sends offerAccepted
findings.body: On a valid offer, an auxclick with button 2 goes through `press` without any check of which mouse button was used. Just opening the context menu saves the setup data and sends offerAccepted, even though the visitor hasn't moved on to accepting the offer. amazon-checkup-offer.tsx:499–511 has the same bug. The reviewer reports that this predates the change. The existing test helper only creates auxclick events with button 1.
findings.fix: In both handlers, skip auxclick when `event.button !== 1`, before saving setup data and sending the event.

findings.title: Reviewed state does not contain the PRD-3672 change: offerAccepted carries no `section`, CTA_SECTIONS has no `ticket`
findings.body: The scope's range 4bdce06aa7..6fbfb05e2f does not contain the described change. Its four commits (bbc3780d79, 97af9240d8, fd74643506, 6fbfb05e2f) are about the partner profile preview. HEAD does not descend from the base (`git merge-base --is-ancestor 4bdce06aa7 HEAD` fails), so the scope's diff command produces a 1,090-file diff that undoes the PRD-3663 CTA work. On HEAD, `press()` (amazon-scorecard-offer.tsx:486-495, and the matching handler at amazon-checkup-offer.tsx:~500-508) builds `accepted = { offerKey, company?, amazonStoreKey? }` and never reads `data-cta-section`. `CTA_SECTIONS` (site.ts:148) is `['topbar','hero','stepper','custom-row','close-band','body','form','footer']`, with no `ticket`. The scorecard test (amazon-scorecard-offer.test.ts:738) still expects `{ offerKey: 'gift-riverbend', amazonStoreKey: 'cafe-ole' }` with no section. If this state shipped, every acceptance criterion in the goal would fail: the gift ticket, the store block and the closing band all send `offerAccepted` with no `section`, and `ticket` is not a valid `CtaSection`. It also means the stated '406 tests green' result did not exercise the change. I could not review the actual PRD-3672 diff because it is not in this checkout.
findings.fix: Re-run the review against the actual `prd-3672-offer-page-name` head and its merge-base with main, so the diff holds the ~10-file change the scope describes.

findings.title: The CTA tests that would catch lost analytics are deleted
findings.body: The scoped range deletes the tests `marks every tracked marketing interaction as a CTA` and `has its approved CTA identity`. Those tests would catch exactly what this diff does: removing `data-cta` from the offer-accept buttons on both offer pages. No CTA checks remain in the console tests. The comparison of generated HTML against the components stays green when the attributes are removed from both sides. The change therefore removes the guard against the regression PRD-3672 forbids, since ctaClicked must keep a consistent name and section.
findings.fix: Restore the CTA tests and the matching markup. For the offer-page buttons, check the sections `ticket`, `hero` and `close-band`.

findings.title: Reviewed range lacks the PRD-3672 change and reverts merged ctaClicked instrumentation
findings.body: The scope's range 4bdce06aa7..6fbfb05e2f is not a forward diff of the PRD-3672 branch. The base 4bdce06aa7 (#6813) is not an ancestor of HEAD; merge-base is 79810ee497, and HEAD is four unrelated 'partner preview' commits. The diff is effectively #6813/#6810/#6811/#6812 and other main work reversed, plus the partner-preview changes (44 marketing files, +623/-4143, vs the scope's 10 files, +114/-14). On HEAD: (1) offerAccepted in amazon-scorecard-offer.tsx:490-495 and amazon-checkup-offer.tsx:503-508 sends only {offerKey, company?, amazonStoreKey?}; there is no `section`, so no Start button sends 'ticket'/'hero'/'close-band'. (2) console/components/marketing/site.ts drops CTA_NAMES, CTA_SECTIONS, ctaAttrs and BOOK_CALL_PLACEMENTS, so 'ticket' is not a CtaSection, and contactEmailHtml loses its data-cta/data-cta-section attributes, which removes the PRD-3663 ctaClicked naming from public pages. (3) internal-dev-doc/posthog-session-replay.md drops the ctaClicked bullet, and .claude/skills/offer-pages/SKILL.md loses its 'Where an offer goes today' table and gets an older description back; neither mentions offerAccepted.section. Every 'Correct only if' condition in the goal fails on this state, and a PR opened from it would revert merged instrumentation and docs. The supplied '406 tests green' cannot apply to this HEAD.
findings.fix: Regenerate the review from the actual prd-3672-offer-page-name branch tip, diffed against its merge-base with main. This checkout has no ref for that branch. Then re-review the offer pages, site.ts, the tests and the two docs.

findings.title: Fixed summary bar can cover focused controls in the minis list; no scroll-padding reserves its height
findings.body: `.minis-summary-bar` is `position: fixed; inset-block-start: 0; z-index: 40` with `min-block-size: 3rem` plus padding and border. It's visible the whole time the user works in the minis list. Nothing reserves space for it: only the header card gets `scroll-margin-block-start`, and the scroller has no `scroll-padding-block-start`. When a keyboard user Shift+Tabs upward through the row controls (count, height, custom size, delete), the browser scrolls each newly focused control only to the top edge, which puts it under the bar. The focused control is then hidden, which fails WCAG 2.4.11 (Focus Not Obscured). The old layout had no fixed overlay, so this is new with the change.
findings.fix: Reserve the bar's height while it's shown, e.g. `html:has(.minis-summary-bar[data-visible='true']) { scroll-padding-block-start: 4rem; }`, or give the row controls a matching `scroll-margin-block-start`.

findings.title: "Изменить" focuses the trigger before scrolling, so the smooth scroll and reduced-motion branch rarely take effect
findings.body: The bar's "Изменить" handler calls `firstField?.focus()` without `preventScroll`. When the header card is off-screen, this makes the browser scroll the Формат trigger into view instantly. Only after that does `header.scrollIntoView({ behavior: shouldAnimate ? 'smooth' : 'auto' })` run, so in the usual case it animates just the last few pixels to the card's top. The `prefers-reduced-motion` check therefore decides almost nothing, and motion-tolerant users get a jump instead of the intended smooth return. Focus still lands on Формат and the card ends up in view, so the impact is limited to the transition.
findings.fix: Call `firstField?.focus({ preventScroll: true })`, or call `scrollIntoView` first and then focus with `preventScroll: true`.

findings.title: Ошибка скачивания скрыта от пользователя панели
findings.body: Если создание PDF или object URL завершится ошибкой при скачивании из закреплённой панели, сообщение об ошибке появится только в карточке настроек, которая уже находится за пределами экрана. Пользователь видит, что скачивание не началось, но не видит причину или предложение повторить попытку.
findings.fix: Показывать статус и ошибки скачивания также рядом с кнопкой закреплённой панели.

findings.title: Settings summary in the bar is truncated to one line on narrow screens
findings.body: The summary uses `truncate` and sits on a single line. On a mobile-width screen, the string with format, margins, base style, trim, numbering and scale doesn't fit, so the last settings disappear behind an ellipsis. There's no other way to expand the summary, so the user can't check those settings in the bar before downloading the PDF.
findings.fix: Let the summary wrap onto several lines on narrow screens, or give another way to see the full text.

findings.title: Браузерный тест не проверяет закрытие и возврат фокуса popover
findings.body: Сценарий открывает настройки масштаба, вводит допустимое значение и нажимает Tab, но не проверяет закрытие по Escape или внешнему нажатию, возврат фокуса и восстановление недопустимого значения при закрытии. Поэтому браузерные регрессии этих действий не нарушат этот тест, хотя цель изменения требует проверять их в браузере.
findings.fix: Добавить браузерные сценарии закрытия по Escape и внешнему нажатию с проверкой фокуса, восстановленного значения и доступности PDF.

findings.title: Summary-bar PDF button gives no visible status; busy, draft-error and failure text render only in the off-screen header card
findings.body: The bar's `Скачать PDF` calls the same `download()` and uses the same `disabled={!canGenerate}` as the card's button. All the feedback for that action is rendered only inside `.minis-header-pdf`: `message` (the failure text set by `reportPdfFailure`), the busy/preparing status and `draftError`. The bar is visible only while that card is out of view. Before this change the settings aside was `position: sticky`, so that text stayed on screen. Failure cases: (1) the user scrolls down, clicks the bar's PDF button, and PDF or object-URL creation fails. The error appears in the off-screen card, so a sighted user sees nothing happen. (2) The user enters an invalid copy count in a row far down. The bar's button goes disabled, but the reason is shown only in the hidden card. Also, the bar's button keeps the fixed label and `aria-label` «Скачать PDF» while `busy`, whereas the card's button switches to «Подготовка PDF…».
findings.fix: Mirror the card in the bar: use `busy ? 'Подготовка PDF…' : 'Скачать PDF'` for its label and aria-label, and show `draftError || message` (or a short status) in `.minis-summary-content`.

findings.title: `Изменить` focuses before scrolling, so the default focus scroll jumps the page and cancels the requested smooth scroll
findings.body: `firstField?.focus()` is called without `{ preventScroll: true }`. By default `focus()` scrolls the element into view immediately. The later `header.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' })` then has almost no distance left to animate. With motion allowed, the user gets an instant jump plus a small adjustment, not the slide the code chooses through `matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference)')`. The `shouldAnimate` branch has almost no effect.
findings.fix: Call `firstField?.focus({ preventScroll: true })`, or call `scrollIntoView` first and focus with `preventScroll`.

findings.title: New popover primitive hard-codes `ring-1 ring-foreground/10` and its only consumer adds `border`, so the edge renders twice
findings.body: The sibling primitive `src/components/ui/dropdown-menu.tsx:32` outlines its popover with `ring-1 ring-border`, which is the semantic border token. The new `Popover` uses `ring-1 ring-foreground/10`. Its only caller (`PaperMinisGenerator.tsx:786`) then passes `rounded-lg border border-border bg-surface-elevated p-4 shadow-md`. `cn`/tailwind-merge keeps both `ring-1` and `border`, so the scale popover gets a 1px ring outside a 1px border. The caller also restates `rounded-lg`, `shadow-md` and the background the primitive already sets, and passes a `minis-scale-popover` class that has no CSS rule anywhere (rg found only this usage). The primitive's defaults are mostly overridden by its only caller.
findings.fix: Use `ring-border` in the primitive, matching dropdown-menu, and drop `border border-border rounded-lg shadow-md bg-surface-elevated minis-scale-popover` from the call site, leaving only the width/padding overrides.

findings.title: The total (`N миниатюр · M лист A4`) now renders twice in the PDF column
findings.body: The change adds `.minis-header-total` showing `totalSummary` directly above the `Скачать PDF` button. It also keeps the `#pdf-summary` span inside that button, which renders the same `totalSummary`. With one or more minis, the PDF column shows the identical string twice, a few pixels apart. Issue #151 specifies the serif total followed by the button, not a second copy inside the button.
findings.fix: Keep `#pdf-summary` for `aria-describedby` but point it at the `.minis-header-total` paragraph (give it the id), and remove the duplicate span from inside the button.

findings.title: Sticky-bar e2e assertions don't pin the bar's real on-screen visibility, so CSS regressions go unnoticed
findings.body: Two gaps mean the test can't tell when the bar's CSS breaks. (1) The 'visible' checks use `toBeVisible()`, which doesn't require the element to be in the viewport, and Playwright scrolls the PDF button into view before clicking it. If `.minis-summary-bar` lost `position: fixed` and rendered in document flow, every assertion would still pass. (2) The 'hidden' checks query `getByRole('button', { name: 'Изменить' })`, which skips aria-hidden subtrees. The bar has `aria-hidden={!headerOutOfView}`, so `toBeHidden()` passes no matter what CSS applies. Removing `visibility: hidden; transform: translateY(-100%)` from the base rule would leave the bar permanently covering the top of the page, and the test would stay green. The goal asks that the browser test fail if the bar's visibility broke.
findings.fix: Query the bar in a way that ignores accessibility state (`page.locator('.minis-summary-bar')`, or `includeHidden: true`). Assert `not.toBeInViewport()`/`toBeHidden()` while the header is in view, and `toBeInViewport()` (or `boundingBox().y` ≈ 0) after scrolling, before clicking its PDF button.

findings.title: «Изменить» focuses the Формат trigger before scrolling, so the smooth scroll and reduced-motion branch have almost no effect
findings.body: The bar's «Изменить» handler calls `firstField?.focus()` without `preventScroll`. While the bar is visible, the header card is above the viewport, so `focus()` instantly scrolls the Формат trigger into view. The later `header.scrollIntoView({ behavior: shouldAnimate ? 'smooth' : 'auto', block: 'start' })` then has only a few pixels left to animate. Users without reduced motion get the same instant jump as users with it, so the `prefers-reduced-motion` check decides almost nothing. Focus still lands correctly, so the impact is limited to the transition.
findings.fix: Call `firstField?.focus({ preventScroll: true })`, or run `scrollIntoView` first and then focus with `preventScroll: true`.

findings.title: Summary-bar PDF button keeps the label «Скачать PDF» during generation, unlike the card's button
findings.body: The card's button switches to `aria-label`/text «Подготовка PDF…» while `busy` (lines 872/877). The busy and draft-error status lines are also in the card. The bar's button has a fixed `aria-label="Скачать PDF"` and text. So after a user starts a download from the bar, which is the main reason the bar exists (the card is off-screen), the only visible feedback is a dimmed «Скачать PDF» while the PDF renders. The status text and the reason the button is disabled are both in the off-screen card. The goal says the bar's actions should do what the card's do, and here the bar's control states something different from the card's.
findings.fix: Reuse the card's label in the bar: `aria-label={busy ? 'Подготовка PDF…' : 'Скачать PDF'}` and the same text.

findings.title: Summary bar's translucent blurred backdrop contradicts DESIGN.md's ban on glassmorphism
findings.body: docs/DESIGN.md:58 says «Без градиентов, теней-стекляшек, glassmorphism», and line 154 says not to use drop-shadow by default. The new `.minis-summary-bar` combines a 94%-opaque `color-mix(... transparent)` background, `backdrop-filter: blur(0.75rem)` and a `box-shadow`, which is the frosted-glass treatment the design doc rules out. The same change edits DESIGN.md but doesn't record this exception and doesn't mention the summary bar at all. A later contributor following the doc would treat the two as in conflict.
findings.fix: Use an opaque `var(--color-surface-elevated)` background with the existing border and no backdrop blur. Otherwise, record the exception for the summary bar in DESIGN.md.

findings.title: Browser test never checks that closing the popover restores an invalid draft or returns focus
findings.body: The browser scenario opens the printer-scale popover, enters a valid value (97) and presses Tab. It never enters an invalid value such as 79 and then closes the popover with Escape or an outside click, so in a real browser it never checks the restored draft, that the PDF actions are enabled again, or that focus returns to the trigger. Component tests do cover all of this in happy-dom (`PaperMinisGenerator.test.tsx:100-206`: Escape and outside pointerdown, restored value, PDF actions, focus return). The gap is limited to browser-only failures, such as a real pointerdown/pointerup click sequence or an overlay catching the outside click. The goal lists browser-test coverage of dismissal and focus return, so the gap is worth closing. The project's own rule, though, is to add browser scenarios only for behaviour happy-dom can't see, so this is a minor coverage gap, not a major one.
findings.fix: Add browser scenarios: enter an invalid value, close with Escape and with an outside click, then assert the restored value, that the PDF actions are enabled, and that focus returns to the trigger on Escape.

findings.title: Summary-bar PDF button has no visible status; busy/draft-error/failure text renders only in the off-screen header card
findings.body:
Observed: the bar's `Скачать PDF` (line 946) calls the same `download()` and uses the same `disabled={!canGenerate}` as the card's button. All the feedback for that action is rendered only inside `.minis-header-pdf`, though: `message` (the `$message` failure text set in the store's catch at paper-minis-store.ts ~1014), the busy text 'Создаём PDF…', the preparing text, and `draftError`. The bar is visible only while that card is out of the viewport (IntersectionObserver at line 517). Before this change the card was `position: sticky` (the removed `.minis-settings > aside` rule), so this text stayed on screen next to the PDF button.

What follows: a user scrolls down to the rows and edits a row count to an invalid value. The bar's PDF button greys out, and the reason (rowDraftError) only appears in the card above. Likewise, if they click the bar's PDF button and generation fails, the failure message appears off-screen, so a sighted user sees the button become usable again with no explanation. Screen-reader users still hear the `role=status` regions. The bar's label also never changes to 'Подготовка PDF…', unlike the card's button. This is a regression from the sticky sidebar, but it only affects feedback: the action itself works.
findings.fix: Show `draftError`/`message`/busy state in the bar as well (e.g. swap the settings summary span for the status text when present, and mirror the card's `busy ? 'Подготовка PDF…' : 'Скачать PDF'` label), or point the bar's button at the status text with aria-describedby and a visible cue.

findings.title: Fixed summary bar overlays the top ~3.5rem of the viewport with no scroll-padding compensation
findings.body:
Observed: `.minis-summary-bar` is `position: fixed; inset-block-start: 0; z-index: 40` with `min-block-size: 3rem` content plus padding, and it is visible whenever the header card is out of view, which covers the whole time the user works in the minis list. No `scroll-padding-block-start` is set on the scroller (only the header card itself gets `scroll-margin-block-start: 1rem`), so the browser does not account for the bar when it scrolls a focused element into view.

What follows (inferred, not run): when a keyboard user Shift+Tabs upward through the row controls (count inputs, height pickers, remove buttons), the browser scrolls each newly focused control just to the top edge, under the opaque bar. The focus ring and control are hidden (WCAG 2.4.11). The project profile counts a control that can't be reached or understood with a keyboard as a reportable failure. This is new with the change: the old layout had no fixed overlay.
findings.fix: Set `scroll-padding-block-start` on the root to the bar's height while the bar is shown (e.g. `html:has(.minis-summary-bar[data-visible='true']) { scroll-padding-block-start: 4rem; }`), or give row controls a matching `scroll-margin-block-start`.

findings.title: Сводка настроек обрезается на узком экране
findings.body: На узком экране класс truncate обрезает сводку в одну строку. При включённых обрезке, нумерации и масштабе часть настроек скрыта за многоточием, когда карточка ушла из вида. Другого способа раскрыть сводку нет, поэтому пользователь не может проверить эти параметры перед скачиванием PDF.
findings.fix: Разрешить сводке переноситься на несколько строк на узких экранах.

findings.title: Кнопка сводки сообщает об ошибке в карточке вне экрана
findings.body: Если создание PDF или создание URL для скачивания завершается ошибкой после нажатия кнопки в сводке, сообщение об ошибке отображается только в карточке настроек. Карточка в этот момент вне экрана, поэтому пользователь не видит причину отсутствия загрузки.
findings.fix: Показать сообщение о результате рядом с кнопкой в сводке или в другом видимом месте.

findings.title: Браузерный сценарий не проверяет закрытие popover и возврат фокуса
findings.body: Браузерный тест вводит корректное измерение и нажимает Tab, но не проверяет закрытие popover по Escape или внешнему клику, возврат фокуса и восстановление некорректного черновика. Регрессия этих действий, проявляющаяся только в браузере, оставит этот тест зелёным, хотя цель изменения требует проверять их в браузере.
findings.fix: Добавить браузерные действия Escape и внешнего клика и проверить закрытие, фокус и доступность PDF после некорректного ввода.

findings.title: The e2e 'bar hidden' checks pass from aria-hidden alone, so a CSS change that leaves the bar always on screen goes unnoticed
findings.body:
`edit` is `page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Изменить' })`. Playwright's getByRole skips aria-hidden subtrees by default. The bar gets `aria-hidden={!headerOutOfView}` (PaperMinisGenerator.tsx:917), so while the header is in view the locator matches nothing, and `toBeHidden()` at lines 298 and 328 passes no matter what CSS is applied. The CSS that actually hides the bar is `visibility: hidden` plus `transform: translateY(-100%)` in `.minis-summary-bar` (global.css:~304-305), and no test pins it.

A change that goes unnoticed: drop `visibility: hidden; transform: translateY(-100%)` from the base `.minis-summary-bar` rule, or make the base rule visible. The fixed bar (z-index 40) would then always cover the top of the page, including over the header card, and both hidden-assertions would still pass. The goal asks that the browser test fail if the bar's visibility broke. Today it only fails when the IntersectionObserver state is wrong, not when the CSS is.
findings.fix: Query the bar with something that ignores accessibility state, e.g. `page.locator('.minis-summary-bar')` or `getByRole('button', { name: 'Изменить', includeHidden: true })`, and assert `toBeHidden()` / `not.toBeInViewport()` on it.

findings.title: The standalone popover-dismissal test only repeats what the parameterised close test and the focus-return test already check
findings.body:
Any code change that breaks Escape or outside-click dismissal also turns these other tests red:
- The `test.each` 'closing the printer scale with $close…' test (line 115). Once the popover stays open, `onOpenChange(false)` never runs, so the invalid '79' draft is never committed. Then `enabledAfterClose` is `[false,false,false]`, and clicking `triggerName` toggles the popover closed, so `getByRole('spinbutton')` throws.
- The focus-return test, which asserts `open: false` after Escape.

I could not find a code change that turns line 208 red while leaving those two green. It costs extra suite time and a second place to update, and it does not say which test owns the dismissal check.
findings.fix: Delete the standalone test, or fold its open-before-close check into the `test.each` case so one test owns dismissal.

findings.title: Reviewed HEAD does not contain the PRD-3672 change: offerAccepted sends no `section` and `ticket` is not a CtaSection
findings.body:
On the reviewed HEAD, `press()` builds `accepted` from `offerKey` plus optional `company` and `amazonStoreKey` only, with no `section`. This is at amazon-scorecard-offer.tsx:490-495, and the same code is in amazon-checkup-offer.tsx:504-508. A press on the gift ticket, the store block or the closing band records an identical `offerAccepted`, so PostHog can't tell which button was pressed and PRD-3672 is not delivered.

Several reviewers trace this to the range itself. Base 4bdce06aa7 (#6813, "Name every call-to-action click") is not an ancestor of HEAD 6fbfb05e2f: the merge base is 79810ee497, and HEAD's own commits are partner-preview work. The two-dot diff therefore reverts #6813 and later main work instead of adding the feature.

On HEAD, site.ts has no `CTA_SECTIONS`, `CtaSection` or `ctaAttrs`. No offer page uses `data-cta-section`. Neither SKILL.md nor posthog-session-replay.md mentions `offerAccepted`. The reported "406 tests green" can't be evidence for the feature: amazon-scorecard-offer.test.ts:738 still expects `{ offerKey, amazonStoreKey }` with no section.
findings.fix: Review the actual `prd-3672-offer-page-name` tip, with its merge-base with main (or 4bdce06aa7 after a rebase) as the base. That tip should read `data-cta-section` from the pressed button into `offerAccepted` on both pages, with `ticket`, `hero` and `close-band` assigned. Re-run the tests there.

findings.title: offerAccepted не содержит section на обеих страницах
findings.body: Существующий обработчик отправляет offerAccepted с offerKey и необязательными company и amazonStoreKey, но без section. Поэтому нажатия на gift ticket, store block и closing band нельзя различить в PostHog. Тот же код есть в amazon-checkup-offer.tsx:504. Отсутствие section существовало до этого diff; в проверенном состоянии требуемое изменение не реализовано.
findings.fix: Добавить section из data-cta-section нажатой кнопки и назначить кнопкам ticket, hero и close-band на обеих страницах.

findings.title: The reviewed commit does not contain the PRD-3672 change: offerAccepted still has no `section`, and CTA_SECTIONS has no `ticket`
findings.body:
The scope names branch `prd-3672-offer-page-name` and the range 4bdce06aa7..6fbfb05e2f. HEAD 6fbfb05e2f is a detached commit on a partner-preview line: its own commits are "Lock partner preview note contract", "fix: explain partner profile preview state", "Lock partner preview readiness handshake" and "fix: remove eager partner preview post". `git merge-base --is-ancestor 4bdce06aa7 6fbfb05e2f` returns 1, so the base is not an ancestor of HEAD. The two-dot diff is therefore 9.6 MB of unrelated main-line commits shown reversed, not the stated 10 files and +114/-14. The three-dot diff touches 13 partner-profile files and none of the files listed in scope.

On HEAD the goal's conditions fail:
- `press()` in amazon-scorecard-offer.tsx:491-495 builds `{ offerKey, company?, amazonStoreKey? }`. It never reads `go.dataset.ctaSection`. The same holds in amazon-checkup-offer.tsx:504-508.
- Neither offer page uses `ctaAttrs` or `data-cta-section` (grep finds nothing).
- `CTA_SECTIONS` in console/components/marketing/site.ts:148 is still `['topbar','hero','stepper','custom-row','close-band','body','form','footer']`, with no `ticket`.
- `offerAccepted` is not mentioned in .claude/skills/offer-pages/SKILL.md or internal-dev-doc/posthog-session-replay.md.

`git log --all -G"'ticket'" -- console/components/marketing/site.ts` finds no commit on any ref. If this state goes into the PR, a press on the gift ticket, the store block or the closing band records an identical `offerAccepted` with no `section`, so PRD-3672 is not delivered. The "406 tests green" in the goal cannot have run against this commit's offer-page code, because the expected `section` assertions do not exist here (amazon-scorecard-offer.test.ts:738 still expects `{ offerKey, amazonStoreKey }` only).
findings.fix: Re-run the review against the actual `prd-3672-offer-page-name` head, with a base that is its merge-base with main. In this checkout, no ref holds that commit.

findings.title: offerAccepted still doesn't identify which button was pressed
findings.body: Any Start button press sends `offerAccepted` with `offerKey` and optional `company`/`amazonStoreKey`, but no `section` (lines 486-495, and amazon-checkup-offer.tsx lines 499-508). Analytics can't tell ticket, hero and close-band apart, which the change's goal requires. Removing `data-cta-section` from the buttons also removes the source the section was supposed to be read from.
findings.fix: Put the right `data-cta-section` on each button and add its value to the `offerAccepted` payload on both pages.

findings.title: Удалён учёт нажатий CTA на публичных страницах
findings.body: Diff удаляет data-cta с кнопок предложения, а также обработчик ctaClicked из console/components/marketing/document.tsx. Поэтому нажатия больше не отправляют ctaClicked ни для этих кнопок, ни для остальных публичных CTA. Это нарушает существующий контракт событий, описанный в internal-dev-doc/posthog-session-replay.md на базовой ревизии, и требование сохранить согласованность ctaClicked с новыми секциями.
findings.fix: Сохранить обработчик ctaClicked и атрибуты CTA, назначив кнопкам предложения нужные секции.

findings.title: Инструкция направляет агента на устаревший способ публикации
findings.body: Шаг подготовки offer в продукте требует опубликовать страницы на offers.membrane.agency «как описано выше». Но раздел Publishing выше описывает только pages:publish на membrane.agency/p/<key>; для старого хоста он называет скрипт на машине Daniil, не давая команды. Агент, выполняющий этот процесс, не может получить указанную исходную страницу через описанный способ.
findings.fix: Укажите актуальный способ получить опубликованные страницы и согласуйте его с разделом Publishing.

findings.title: Tests that checked CTA identity and sections on marketing links, including the offer buttons, are deleted
findings.body: Base 4bdce06's marketing-render.test.ts checked data-cta and data-cta-section on built links. That included the offer pages' `.pp-close-band` accept-offer/close-band buttons and the book-call placements. The range diff deletes those checks along with the attributes and ctaClicked tracking. The cause is that HEAD 6fbfb05 does not descend from base 4bdce06, so the diff reverses #6813 instead of adding a `ticket` section. The remaining committed-output-matches-components test passes without the attributes, so nothing would catch the lost instrumentation if this range shipped.
findings.fix: Same fix as the site.ts finding: rebase the branch on 4bdce06 or a later main so #6813's CTA tests survive. Then extend them with the expected ticket, hero and close-band sections.

findings.title: Test locks in an offerAccepted payload with no section
findings.body: The test expects an exact payload with no `section` and only checks the first button, so it locks in the old behavior instead of the PRD-3672 contract. A press on the ticket, the store block or the close band yields an event that doesn't identify its source. The Checkup test has the same expectation.
findings.fix: On both pages, assert the events from all three buttons with sections `ticket`, `hero` and `close-band`.

findings.title: Reviewed range is not the PRD-3672 change: base is not an ancestor of HEAD, so the diff reverts PR #6813's CTA tracking instead of adding offerAccepted.section
findings.body: Observed: `git merge-base --is-ancestor 4bdce06aa7 6fbfb05e2f` fails. HEAD 6fbfb05e2f is a detached checkout of unrelated partner-preview commits, and `git diff base..HEAD` covers 1090 files (+45913/-89634), not the 10 files the scope describes. On the in-scope files, the diff does the opposite of the goal. (1) offerAccepted at amazon-scorecard-offer.tsx:490-495, and the checkup page around line 508, sends only {offerKey, company?, amazonStoreKey?}. There is no `section`. (2) site.ts deletes CTA_NAMES, CTA_SECTIONS, ctaAttrs and BOOK_CALL_PLACEMENTS, so `ticket` cannot be a valid CtaSection. (3) Both offer pages strip data-cta/data-cta-section from the gift ticket, store block, blocked notice, taken link and close-band primary/blocked CTAs. (4) internal-dev-doc/posthog-session-replay.md removes the ctaClicked and offerViewed/offerAccepted bullets, and SKILL.md's funnel table changes too. What follows: shipping this range would drop ctaClicked attribution from the offer pages and remove the CTA vocabulary other pages import. None of the goal's 'Correct only if' conditions hold. The supplied '406 tests green / typecheck 0' result does not establish that the feature exists, because the changed test regexes only drop the `[^>]*` that tolerated data-cta attributes. Not a code defect in the intended change: the review target is wrong. Re-run against the actual prd-3672-offer-page-name tip, with its merge-base as the base.
findings.fix: Point the review at the real prd-3672-offer-page-name commit and use `git diff $(git merge-base main <tip>)..<tip>`; do not ship 4bdce06aa7..6fbfb05e2f.

findings.title: С кнопок удалены атрибуты CTA, а общий обработчик кликов удалён
findings.body: На обеих страницах ссылки принятия offer больше не имеют атрибутов data-cta и data-cta-section. Из POSTHOG_SCRIPT также удалён обработчик ctaClicked. Поэтому нажатия на ticket, store block и closing band больше не отправляют ctaClicked; это нарушает требование сохранить событие с соответствующей секцией.
findings.fix: Восстановить обработчик ctaClicked и атрибуты CTA для кнопок обеих страниц с нужными значениями section.

findings.title: Payload offerAccepted не содержит section
findings.body: При нажатии любой доступной кнопки объект accepted содержит offerKey и, при наличии, company и amazonStoreKey, но не section. Аналогичный обработчик есть на странице Checkup. Поэтому по offerAccepted невозможно определить нажатую кнопку. Это отсутствие поля существовало до указанного диапазона изменений; в рассматриваемом состоянии цель изменения остаётся невыполненной.
findings.fix: Передавать в accepted значение data-cta-section нажатой кнопки и задать ticket, hero и close-band соответствующим кнопкам на обеих страницах.

findings.title: Reviewed HEAD does not contain the PRD-3672 change: offerAccepted carries no `section`, and the range diff reverts PRD-3663's CTA attributes
findings.body:
The supplied range 4bdce06aa7..6fbfb05e2f is not a linear range. `git merge-base` returns 79810ee497, so base 4bdce06aa7 (PRD-3663, #6813, "Name every call-to-action click") is not an ancestor of HEAD. HEAD's four commits are partner-preview work (bbc3780d79..6fbfb05e2f). The diff covers 1090 files, not the 10 the scope describes.

What HEAD actually contains:
- `press()` builds `var accepted = { offerKey: key }` and adds only `company` and `amazonStoreKey`, with no `section`. This is at amazon-scorecard-offer.tsx:491-495 and the same code at amazon-checkup-offer.tsx:504-508.
- `console/components/marketing/site.ts` has no `CTA_SECTIONS`, `ctaAttrs`, `CTA_NAMES` or `BOOK_CALL_PLACEMENTS`.
- Over the scoped files, the diff strips `data-cta='accept-offer'` / `data-cta-section='body'` from the gift ticket, store block and blocked-notice buttons, and drops `ctaName` from the close band.

Every 'correct only if' condition in the goal fails on this state: the ticket, store block and close band don't send `ticket` / `hero` / `close-band`, and `ticket` is not a valid CtaSection because the type doesn't exist. Shipping this tree as the PR would drop the CTA naming from #6813 rather than extend it.

The reported "406 tests green" doesn't count as evidence for the feature. The scorecard test at amazon-scorecard-offer.test.ts:738 expects `['offerAccepted', { offerKey: 'gift-riverbend', amazonStoreKey: 'cafe-ole' }, ...]` with no section, so the green run confirms the absence of the feature.
findings.fix: Review the actual `prd-3672-offer-page-name` tip, or rebase it onto 4bdce06aa7, and confirm `git merge-base --is-ancestor 4bdce06aa7 <head>` succeeds. Then re-run the 3 test files on that state; the offerAccepted expectations should include `section`.

findings.title: Удалены проверки идентичности CTA на страницах offer
findings.body: Из теста удалены проверки, которые требовали для кнопок закрывающего блока обеих страниц CTA `accept-offer` и секцию `close-band`. В том же diff эти атрибуты и обработчик `ctaClicked` удалены, поэтому нажатия больше не дают событие, а оставшиеся тесты не обнаруживают потерю. Удалённые проверки могли стать красными при этом изменении; нового владельца этого контракта в тестах нет.
findings.fix: Вернуть отслеживание CTA и проверки его идентичности, учитывая новые значения секций для ticket и hero.

findings.title: Тест запрещает дополнительные атрибуты рабочих ссылок
findings.body: Изменённое выражение требует, чтобы `target="_top"` был последним атрибутом ссылки. Добавление корректного `data-cta` или атрибута доступности после него сделает тест красным, хотя ссылка по-прежнему ведёт на нужную страницу. Такое же ограничение добавлено в тест Scorecard.
findings.fix: Проверять адрес и текст ссылки независимо от наличия и порядка других атрибутов.

findings.title: The range diff deletes CTA_NAMES, CTA_SECTIONS, ctaAttrs and BOOK_CALL_PLACEMENTS instead of adding a `ticket` section
findings.body: HEAD 6fbfb05 is not a descendant of base 4bdce06 (#6813), so the range undoes #6813 and later main commits. In site.ts it deletes `CTA_NAMES`, `CTA_SECTIONS`, `CtaSection`, `ctaAttrs` and `BOOK_CALL_PLACEMENTS`, and strips `data-cta`/`data-cta-section` from `contactEmailHtml`. `ticket` exists nowhere on HEAD. Shipping this diff would remove `ctaClicked` instrumentation from every public page instead of adding `offerAccepted.section`.
findings.fix: Point the review range (and the PR) at the real `prd-3672-offer-page-name` tip, rebased on 4bdce06 or a later main. Don't ship 4bdce06..6fbfb05.

findings.title: Offer-pages skill goes back to describing the Slack Start button and the offers.membrane.agency publish target as current
findings.body: This comes from the same base/HEAD mismatch, and it changes what an agent does. The diff deletes the 'Where an offer goes today' table, the 'The funnel and its events' table (which documented `offerAccepted` for step 2) and the trigger words `offerViewed`/`offerAccepted`/`scorecard/amazon/offer`. In their place it restores 'The Start button posts a message to the #growth channel in Slack' as current behavior, and step 1 'publish them at offers.membrane.agency as above', whereas base calls that host legacy, with publishing ended. An agent this skill triggers on to answer 'where does offer traffic land' or 'why does a funnel step show no events' would no longer load it. One that does load it would say Start posts to Slack and would publish to a host that's retired. The base doc also has an `offerAccepted` bullet in `internal-dev-doc/posthog-session-replay.md` that this diff deletes. The goal requires the docs to describe `offerAccepted.section`, and neither doc mentions it on HEAD.
findings.fix: Review the actual PRD-3672 branch. Its SKILL.md should keep base's funnel table and add `section` to step 2.

findings.title: Nothing would catch the sync entry going back to unbounded thread reads
findings.body: The commit says the sync entry's thread reads (entries/ux-chain-sync.ts:247-254) now go through mapBounded "so a long sync gap cannot fan out either". The only test of the bound is the 120-issue listCandidates test in linear-port.test.ts, and that one drives trackerFromLinearPort, not the sync entry. sync-entry.test.ts already runs the real routine against a fake port (its listThread stub is at line 450), but no test there counts how many reads are in flight. If someone puts `Promise.all(issues.map(...))` back into ux-chain-sync.ts, every test stays green. A sync after a long watermark gap would then send one listThread per updated issue all at once, which is the failure this ticket fixes.
findings.fix: In sync-entry.test.ts, add a case where listIssues returns more than 8 issues that need a thread read. Have the fake listThread track in-flight calls the same way the linear-port test does, and assert the peak is 8.

findings.title: Rate-limit guard matches any error with data.key 'rate_limit_exceeded', not only a MembraneError
findings.body: The doc comment says the guard matches "a MembraneError keyed `rate_limit_exceeded`", and the goal says to retry "only a MembraneError". The schema actually used, `Schema.Struct({ data: Schema.Struct({ key: Schema.Literal('rate_limit_exceeded') }) })`, only checks `data.key`. It never checks that the error is a MembraneError, so any thrown object with that shape gets retried. The test fixture sets `isMembraneError: true`, but the guard never reads it, so the tests can't tell the difference. In practice the impact is small, because `client.run` is the only thing that throws here. Still, the comment and the goal describe a narrower check than the code does.
findings.fix: Either add `isMembraneError: Schema.Literal(true)` to RateLimitRefusal, or change the comment to say the guard matches on the data key alone.

findings.title: Is the platform limit on parallel requests or per second, and which refusal carries retryAfterSeconds?
findings.body: linear-graphql.ts:256 says "The parallel-request refusal carries no `retryAfterSeconds`; the per-second one does." bounded.ts:1 says the platform refuses "past 100 parallel requests". But the test fixture rateLimitRefusal in linear-graphql.test.ts uses the message "Rate limit exceeded: 100 apiRequestsPerTenantPerSecond", which is a per-second limit. It also pairs that message with no retryAfterSeconds, which is the opposite of what line 256 claims. The reviewer couldn't check which description matches the platform. The author needs to say whether the limit is on concurrency or on rate, and which refusal carries retryAfterSeconds. That answer decides whether a concurrency cap of 8 is the right fix, and the comments and fixture should then be made to agree with it.

findings.title: Rate-limit guard matches any error with data.key 'rate_limit_exceeded', not only a MembraneError
findings.body: The doc comment says the guard matches "a MembraneError keyed `rate_limit_exceeded`". The goal says to retry only a MembraneError. The schema actually used is `Schema.Struct({ data: Schema.Struct({ key: Schema.Literal('rate_limit_exceeded') }) })`, and it checks only `data.key`. Nothing checks that the error is a MembraneError. So if Commands.run throws a plain Error with `data: { key: 'rate_limit_exceeded' }`, connectionGraphql waits and retries instead of rethrowing straight away. If the retry then succeeds, the caller never sees the original error. The test fixture sets `isMembraneError: true`, but the guard never reads that field, so the tests can't catch this. In practice the impact is likely small, because `client.run` is the only thing that throws here and nobody has confirmed that such an error shows up in the production client. Even so, the code checks less than the comment and the goal say it does.
findings.fix: Add a required `isMembraneError: Schema.Literal(true)` field to RateLimitRefusal, or change the comment to say the guard matches on the data key alone.

findings.title: Тест не различает первый и последний отказ
findings.body: Новый тест заявляет проверку возврата последнего отказа, но все три попытки бросают один объект refusal. Если connectionGraphql сохранит первую ошибку и выбросит её после третьей попытки, обе проверки останутся зелёными. При разных отказах вызывающий код получит устаревшие данные ошибки, а этот тест регрессию не обнаружит.
findings.fix: Бросать отдельный объект ошибки на каждой попытке и проверять идентичность результата третьему объекту. Проверки количества вызовов и ожиданий сохранить.

findings.title: Journald cap can only reach the already-running server by re-running bootstrap.sh, which ENVIRONMENT.md forbids there
findings.body: `configure_journald` is reachable only through `main()` in scripts/bootstrap.sh (line 464). It runs after `set_permissions`, which does `chown -R 1000:1000` and `chmod -R 775/750` over appdata and /mnt/data/{public,users,backups}. ENVIRONMENT.md:176 explicitly says not to run bootstrap.sh on the populated tree. For the analogous smartd change, ENVIRONMENT.md:163 documents a targeted command instead of re-running bootstrap. The new journald docs (ENVIRONMENT.md:138, CLAUDE.md:71) only say that `bootstrap.sh` creates the drop-in and give no way to apply it to the already-running server. The live server is the only host and the target of issue #8. The most likely outcome is that its SSD stays uncapped. The alternative is someone re-running bootstrap and damaging permissions on the data tree.
findings.fix: In ENVIRONMENT.md «Контроль свободного места», document a one-off apply for the existing host, for example: `sudo install -d /etc/systemd/journald.conf.d && printf '[Journal]\nSystemMaxUse=1G\n' | sudo tee /etc/systemd/journald.conf.d/90-homelab.conf && sudo systemctl restart systemd-journald`. Add a note to not re-run bootstrap.sh for this, matching the smartd note. Optionally move the logic into a standalone scripts/setup/NN-*.sh step.

findings.title: ENVIRONMENT.md says the local rollback copy survives the prune, but the prune deletes it
findings.body: Line 139 says that after `docker image prune -f` "образы остановленных сервисов и локальная копия для отката остаются". Most services use moving tags (`latest`, `stable`, `beta`, or no tag). `do_rebuild` runs `compose pull`, then `down`, then `up -d`. The pull moves the tag to the new image, which leaves the previous image untagged. Once the container is replaced, nothing references it. That makes it exactly the dangling image the new prune in rebuild.sh:33 deletes, including when `up -d` fails after `down`. Nothing in the repo re-tags or keeps old images. An operator or agent who trusts this sentence will plan a rollback around a local image that no longer exists. Only the prose is wrong; the script does what the goal specifies.
findings.fix: Drop the 'локальная копия для отката' clause, or state that the prune removes the previous (now untagged) version of a rebuilt image, so a rollback needs a registry pull of a specific tag.

findings.title: Disk-space push messages print free space as a bare number with no unit
findings.body: Both new messages interpolate `states('sensor.…_disk_free')`, which returns only the bare number. The unit (GiB) is in a separate attribute. The push therefore reads, for example, "SSD: занято 87.3%, свободно 41.2." with no unit on the free value. Every other message in this file writes its unit out (`°C`, `RPM`, and `%` for usage here).
findings.fix: Append the unit, e.g. `свободно {{ states('sensor.127_0_0_1_rootfs_disk_free') }} ГБ`, or use `state_attr(..., 'unit_of_measurement')`. Do the same in the RAID message.

findings.title: Dashboard comment still says three groups after a fourth («Место») was added
findings.body: The comment heading the «Сервер» view cards reads "Три группы вместо одной плитки glance…". This change adds a fourth separator group, «Место», above «Диски», «Материнка» and «Вентиляторы», so the comment now describes the old layout.
findings.fix: Change "Три группы" to "Четыре группы", or drop the count.

findings.title: Disk-space alert can be missed for good if HA restarts or reloads around the threshold crossing
findings.body: HA's `numeric_state` trigger fires only when an entity moves from 'not matching' to 'matching'. The trigger is armed at the moment the automation attaches. If HA restarts or automations reload during the 10-minute `for` window, the pending timer is dropped. Once Glances is loaded and already reports usage above 85%, the trigger is not re-armed. The same happens if HA was down when the crossing occurred. Disk usage only climbs, so it rarely drops back under the threshold to cross it again, and the SSD can fill with no push. A Glances unavailable→value blip does re-arm the trigger, which softens this somewhat. The window is narrow, so this is minor, but it weakens the guarantee CLAUDE.md documents (alert above 85%/90%). The RAID automation (lines 70–73) has the same problem.
findings.fix: Add a `platform: homeassistant, event: start` trigger (and optionally a periodic `time_pattern`), plus a `numeric_state` condition with `above: 85` (90 for RAID) and `for: 00:10:00`, so a value already above the threshold still fires. The change stays inside the two new automations.

findings.title: Документация обещает сохранить образ для отката
findings.body: После pull нового образа старый образ может потерять тег, а после пересоздания контейнера стать dangling. `docker image prune -f` удалит такой образ, поэтому локальная копия для отката не всегда сохраняется.
