findings.fix: Убрать обещание о сохранении локальной копии для отката или явно сохранять нужный образ под тегом.

findings.title: ENVIRONMENT.md wrongly says the previous image survives the prune as a rollback copy
findings.body: The new line says that after `docker image prune -f` the images of stopped services *and the local copy for rollback* ("локальная копия для отката") remain. For the 19 services on `:latest` or untagged images (`rg 'image:.*:latest|image: [^:]+$' services/*/docker-compose.yml`), `do_rebuild` runs pull → down → up -d. The tag moves to the new image, and the old container that referenced the previous image is removed. The previous image is now dangling and unused, so the prune added in `rebuild.sh:33` deletes it. No script in the repo re-tags or keeps old images (`rg -i 'rollback|docker tag' scripts` finds nothing). After a rebuild there is no local copy to roll back to. `CLAUDE.md` tells agents to read ENVIRONMENT.md before working on disks, so an agent may plan a rollback around an image that is gone.
findings.fix: Drop the rollback-copy clause, or say that the previous version of a re-pulled `:latest` image is removed by the prune.

findings.title: configure_network still sources config.sh, now redundant after the new top-level source
findings.body: The change adds `source "$PROJECT_DIR/scripts/lib/config.sh"` at script scope (line 66), so all config variables are loaded before `main` runs. The existing `source` inside `configure_network` (line 197) now only re-runs config.sh. That leaves two places loading the same configuration, and a reader can't tell which one is authoritative. Runtime behaviour is unaffected.
findings.fix: Remove the `source "$PROJECT_DIR/scripts/lib/config.sh"` line inside `configure_network`.

findings.title: Disk-space push prints the free-space value with no unit
findings.body: Both new messages interpolate `states('sensor.…_disk_free')`. `states()` returns only the bare state; the Glances disk_free sensor's state is a number whose unit (GiB) lives in a separate attribute. The push therefore reads e.g. "SSD: занято 87.3%, свободно 41.2." with no unit on the free value. Every other message in this file appends its unit explicitly (`°C`, `RPM`), and these messages do the same for usage with `%`.
findings.fix: Append the unit, e.g. `свободно {{ states('sensor.127_0_0_1_rootfs_disk_free') }} ГБ` (or use `state_attr(..., 'unit_of_measurement')`); same for the RAID message.

findings.title: Шаг journald прерывает установку в тестовом контейнере
findings.body: При запуске установки с TEST_MODE=1 из tests/Dockerfile этот шаг всё равно вызывает systemctl restart systemd-journald. В контейнере без запущенного systemd команда завершается с ошибкой, а set -e прерывает bootstrap и установку. Соседние шаги, которым нужен systemd, например configure_smartd в scripts/bootstrap.sh:347, пропускаются в TEST_MODE.
findings.fix: Пропустить настройку journald в TEST_MODE, как другие шаги, зависящие от systemd.

findings.title: Документация обещает сохранить образ для отката
findings.body: При обновлении тега старый образ может стать dangling. После пересоздания контейнера он больше не используется, поэтому docker image prune -f удалит его. Утверждение, что локальная копия для отката остаётся, может привести оператора к попытке отката на уже удалённый образ.
findings.fix: Уточнить, что dangling-версия предыдущего образа может быть удалена.

findings.title: ENVIRONMENT.md says the local rollback copy survives the prune, but the prune is what deletes it
findings.body: The new line says: "Удаляются только dangling images; образы остановленных сервисов и локальная копия для отката остаются." Most services here use moving tags: 17 use `latest`, 3 `stable`, plus `beta`, `alpine`, `latest-full` and an untagged `dperson/samba`. `do_rebuild` runs `compose pull`, then `down` and `up -d`. That moves the tag to the new image, and the previous image is left untagged and unused, which makes it dangling. The new `docker image prune -f` in `rebuild.sh` then deletes it. So after a rebuild the operator has no local previous version to roll back to, even though this document says one stays. The claim only holds when a compose file pins a fixed tag that is still referenced. Images of stopped services do stay, because they are still tagged. Prose only, so minor.
findings.fix: Drop the rollback-copy clause, or say plainly that the previous version of a service on a moving tag (`latest` etc.) becomes dangling after the rebuild and is removed.

findings.title: Comment above the «Сервер» cards still says three groups; the change makes it four
findings.body: The comment heading the view's cards reads "Три группы вместо одной плитки glance: та выкладывала семь разнородных значений в общую сетку". This change adds a fourth separator group, «Место», above «Диски», «Материнка» and «Вентиляторы». The comment now describes the old layout. Comments should describe the current state, so this is a stale comment introduced by the change. The code is right; the comment needs updating.
findings.fix: Change "Три группы" to "Четыре группы", or drop the count.

findings.title: Home Assistant README's alert and dashboard summary omits the new disk-space alerts and the «Место» group
findings.body: The service README lists what `hardware_health.yaml` alerts on: "CPU >85/95 °C, NVMe >75/82 °C, fan-failure". It describes the «Сервер» view as "current temps/fans + 24 h history graphs". The change adds `server_ssd_disk_space_warning` (>85% for 10 min) and `server_raid_disk_space_warning` (>90% for 10 min) to that file, and adds a disk-usage group to that view. Neither is mentioned here, so someone reading the service doc doesn't learn that disk-usage pushes exist or what their thresholds are. The project rule asks for docs to be updated with the change. The root CLAUDE.md, ENVIRONMENT.md and README.md were updated, but this per-service doc, which has the alert list, was not. The RAID temperature alerts were already missing from this list before this change.
findings.fix: Add the root SSD >85% and RAID `/mnt/data` >90% (10 min) alerts to the Alerts bullet, and mention disk usage in the Dashboard bullet.

findings.title: Документация ошибочно обещает сохранить образ для отката
findings.body: После обновления тега старый образ может стать dangling, если контейнер больше его не использует. Команда `docker image prune -f` удалит такой образ, поэтому локальная копия для отката не обязательно останется.
findings.fix: Указать, что предыдущий образ может быть удалён, если он стал dangling.

findings.title: ENVIRONMENT.md says a 'local copy for rollback' survives the prune, but no rollback copy is created and the previous image is the one pruned
findings.body: Line 139 says that after `docker image prune -f` "образы остановленных сервисов и локальная копия для отката остаются". Nothing in the repo creates a rollback copy: there is no `docker tag` or retag anywhere, and `do_rebuild` (scripts/docker/_lib.sh:272-274) just runs `compose pull`, `down`, `up -d`. Observed: `pull` moves the service's tag to the new image, so the previous image is left untagged. After `down`/`up -d` replace the container, nothing references it, and it is exactly the dangling image the new prune in rebuild.sh deletes. That includes a service whose `up -d` failed after `down`, which the goal requires the prune to cover. Inferred consequence: before this change the previous version stayed on disk; now it is removed in the same run. An operator who trusts this sentence will look for a local image that is not there and will have to pull the old version from the registry. Only the prose is wrong. The script behaves as the goal specifies.
findings.fix: Drop the 'локальная копия для отката' clause, or state that pruning removes the previous (now untagged) version of each rebuilt image, so rolling back needs a registry pull.

findings.title: Таймер предупреждения сбрасывается при перезапуске Home Assistant
findings.body: Если диск превысил порог и Home Assistant перезапустился или автоматизации были перезагружены до истечения 10 минут, таймер `for` сбрасывается. После перезапуска `numeric_state` ждёт нового пересечения порога: если заполнение остаётся выше 85%, предупреждение не придёт, пока значение сначала не опустится ниже порога и не превысит его снова. То же относится к RAID на строках 70–73.
findings.fix: Добавить проверку сохраняющегося превышения после запуска или перезагрузки автоматизаций, сохранив задержку в 10 минут.

findings.title: Описание prune обещает сохранить предыдущий образ для отката
findings.body: При обновлении образа по тому же тегу прежний образ может стать dangling. После `compose down` старый контейнер удалён, а `docker image prune -f` может удалить и этот образ. Поэтому утверждение, что локальная копия для отката остаётся, неверно для обычного обновления.
findings.fix: Уточнить, что dangling-образ предыдущей версии может быть удалён и для отката нужен сохранённый тег или другая копия.

findings.title: New CLAUDE.md block copies thresholds and behaviour from elsewhere without pointing to the ENVIRONMENT.md section
findings.body:
The new block repeats facts that already live in other files. The thresholds "root SSD usage above 85% and RAID `/mnt/data` usage above 90%" are defined in `hardware_health.yaml` and repeated in ENVIRONMENT.md «Контроль свободного места». The ENVIRONMENT.md copy also gives the 10-minute duration, which CLAUDE.md leaves out. The rebuild prune behaviour appears both here (line 71) and in the rebuild comment at line 61.

Other hardware blocks in this file end with `Подробности — ENVIRONMENT.md → «…»` (lines 132 and 140). This block has no such pointer. The result is three copies of each threshold with nothing marking which one is authoritative. If someone changes a threshold in the YAML, the always-loaded CLAUDE.md copy goes stale with no warning, and an agent reading it will report or keep the wrong value.

The text is also vague about sensors. It says "use the real rootfs sensors" but never names the entity ids. They are listed only in the header comment of `hardware_health.yaml`.
findings.fix: Keep the guardrails only: no `-a`, no `snap_*`, and the place where the rootfs entity ids are listed (`hardware_health.yaml` header). Replace the numbers with a pointer: `Подробности — ENVIRONMENT.md → «Контроль свободного места»`.

findings.title: The block's trigger "Home Assistant hardware alerts" covers more than its content
findings.body: The trigger is `<important if="you are working with disk space, journald, or Home Assistant hardware alerts">`. `hardware_health.yaml` also holds the CPU temperature and fan alerts, so this block fires whenever an agent edits any of those. Its content is only about disk usage. The extra branch makes the block load into context on work it has nothing to say about, and "Home Assistant hardware alerts" largely overlaps the existing `disk health, SMART` trigger. This changes no behaviour; it only adds context load.
findings.fix: Narrow the trigger to the branch the content serves, e.g. `if="you are working with disk space, journald, or Home Assistant disk-usage alerts"`.

findings.title: Sticky-bar PDF action gives no visible feedback: busy, error and draft-error status render only in the off-screen card
findings.body: The summary bar's 'Скачать PDF' calls the same `download()` as the card. All feedback for that action lives in `.minis-header-pdf`: the 'Создаём PDF…' status, the `message` from `store.reportPdfFailure()`, `draftError`, and the card button's 'Подготовка PDF…' label. The bar only appears while that card is fully out of view. Scenario: a user scrolls to the minis list and clicks the bar's PDF button. Either the button is disabled because a row's count draft is invalid, or generation fails. In both cases the bar shows a plain 'Скачать PDF' button that is either inert or briefly disabled by the fieldset, with no visible reason. The error text is announced only to screen-reader users, through a role=status node outside the viewport. Sighted users get a silent failure, so the bar's action does not fully match the card's.
findings.fix: Show the busy label (`busy ? 'Подготовка PDF…' : 'Скачать PDF'`) on the bar button, and show `message`/`draftError` in the bar, or scroll to the card when either is set.

findings.title: Fixed summary bar can cover keyboard-focused mini controls (no scroll-padding)
findings.body: `.minis-summary-bar` is `position: fixed; inset-block-start: 0` with `min-block-size: 3rem` plus padding, and it is visible exactly while the user works in the minis list. Nothing sets `scroll-padding-block-start` on the scroller. Scenario: the user Shift+Tabs up through mini rows (count inputs, height pickers, delete buttons). The browser scrolls each newly focused control only until it touches the viewport's top edge, which is under the bar, so the focused control is hidden. The project profile counts unreachable or obscured keyboard focus as a reportable failure.
findings.fix: Add `html:has(.minis-summary-bar[data-visible='true']) { scroll-padding-block-start: 4rem; }` (or similar) so focused elements are scrolled clear of the bar.

findings.title: 'Изменить' focuses before scrolling, so the smooth / reduced-motion scroll choice has no visible effect
findings.body: `firstField?.focus()` runs before `header.scrollIntoView({ behavior: shouldAnimate ? 'smooth' : 'auto' })`. A plain `focus()` scrolls the select trigger into view instantly. By the time `scrollIntoView` runs, the header is already mostly on screen, so the smooth animation the `prefers-reduced-motion` check chooses barely happens: the jump is always instant. The code paid for a motion preference check that does nothing.
findings.fix: Use `firstField?.focus({ preventScroll: true })` so that `scrollIntoView` controls the motion.

findings.title: 'Изменить' focuses before scrolling, so the smooth / reduced-motion scroll choice has no visible effect
findings.body: The 'Изменить' handler calls `firstField?.focus()` before `header.scrollIntoView({ behavior: shouldAnimate ? 'smooth' : 'auto', block: 'start' })`. A plain `focus()` scrolls the focused element into view itself. No `scroll-behavior` is set anywhere in src/, so that scroll is instant. Chromium centres the focused element when it has to scroll. So the long jump from the minis list back to the `Формат` trigger happens at once, and the later smooth `scrollIntoView` only moves the remaining distance from about mid-viewport to the card's top edge. Users with `prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference` see an instant jump plus a short glide, not the intended animated return, so the `matchMedia`/`shouldAnimate` branch has almost no effect.
findings.fix: Call `firstField?.focus({ preventScroll: true })` so that `scrollIntoView` alone does the scrolling.

findings.title: `minis-scale-popover` class has no CSS rule or selector anywhere
findings.body: The scale popover gets `className="minis-scale-popover …"`, but `rg minis-scale-popover` over src/, tests/ and docs/ returns only this line. `global.css` defines every other new `minis-*` class added in this change, but not this one, and no test selects by it. The class does nothing and suggests a style hook that doesn't exist.
findings.fix: Remove `minis-scale-popover` from the className, or add the rule it was meant to carry.

findings.title: Accordion primitive loses its last caller after the sidebar removal
findings.body: PaperMinisGenerator's settings sidebar was the only importer of `@/components/ui/accordion`. After this change, `rg "ui/accordion" src` returns nothing, so the module is dead code in the shared ui folder. The file predates this change, but this change is what leaves it unused. Tailwind v4 scans every non-ignored project file for classes, so the accordion's utility classes are still emitted into client CSS. That matters because this change adds about 3.6 kB to `global.css`, which is under a 10 kB Client CSS limit. A future contributor may also end up maintaining or theming a primitive that nothing renders.
findings.fix: Delete `src/components/ui/accordion.tsx`, or keep it on purpose as part of the shadcn primitive set and say so.

findings.title: Shared Popover's built-in ring stacks with the caller's border (double edge), and most default classes get overridden
findings.body:
The new `Popover` primitive ships the full shadcn class string: `w-72 p-2.5 bg-popover shadow-md ring-1 ring-foreground/10`, plus tw-animate enter/exit/zoom/slide utilities. Its only caller, the scale popover at PaperMinisGenerator.tsx:786, overrides width, padding, background, radius and shadow with `rounded-lg border border-border bg-surface-elevated p-4 shadow-md`. That is the same set `SelectContent` uses. `tailwind-merge` treats `ring-*` and `border*` as separate groups and keeps both, so the popover renders a 1px border plus a 1px box-shadow ring outside it.

Neighbouring primitives use only one edge: `DropdownMenuContent` uses `ring-1 ring-border`, `SelectContent` uses `border border-border`. The animation utilities are used by no other ui primitive, so Tailwind emits them only for this popover, and they count against the Client CSS budget.
findings.fix: Give `Popover` the base set `SelectContent` already uses (border border-border bg-surface-elevated rounded-lg shadow-md …) and drop the ring, so the caller only adds width and padding. Or keep the ring as `ring-border` and have callers stop adding a border. Drop the tw-animate utilities unless the motion is wanted.

findings.title: The summary bar's 'Скачать PDF' gives no visible feedback: progress, failure and the reason it is disabled only show in the off-screen card
findings.body:
The goal says the bar's actions must do what the card's do. The click itself does: the bar button calls the same `download()` and uses the same `disabled={!canGenerate}` gate. The feedback around it does not come along. Everything that explains the PDF action lives only in `.minis-header-pdf`:
- the busy status 'Создаём PDF…' and the 'Подготовка PDF…' label,
- `message`, which holds both the success text and the failure text `store.reportPdfFailure` sets,
- `draftError`.

The bar is only visible while that card is out of view (`data-visible={headerOutOfView}`).

How it fails: a user scrolls down a long list of minis and clicks 'Скачать PDF' in the bar.
- If generation fails, the bar looks the same as before. The error only appears in the card above the viewport, so the user gets no PDF and no sign of why.
- If a row's copy count holds an invalid draft, the bar's button is just disabled. The `draftError` text that explains it is off-screen too.

The bar button also keeps `aria-label="Скачать PDF"` while busy, unlike the card button. The fieldset disables it, but it never says the PDF is being prepared.

This was introduced by the change, which added the bar.
findings.fix: Show the busy/failure/draft-error state in the bar too. The smallest version renders `message`/`draftError` (or a short status) next to the bar's buttons. At minimum, mirror the card button's busy label: `aria-label={busy ? 'Подготовка PDF…' : 'Скачать PDF'}` and the matching text.

findings.title: Sticky bar's 'Скачать PDF' gives no visible feedback: busy, failure and draft-error text render only in the off-screen card
findings.body:
The bar's button always reads 'Скачать PDF' and uses the same `download()` and `disabled={!canGenerate}` gate as the card. Everything that explains the action renders only inside `.minis-header-pdf`: the 'Создаём PDF…' busy status, the `message` status (the success text, or the failure text set by `store.reportPdfFailure`), `draftError`, and the card button's 'Подготовка PDF…' label. The bar is visible only while that card is out of view (`data-visible={headerOutOfView}`), so that text is always off-screen while the bar is in use.

Scenario: a user scrolled down to the minis list clicks the bar's PDF button. If generation fails, the bar looks unchanged and the error appears in the card above the viewport, so a sighted user gets no PDF and no explanation. A screen-reader user still hears it through role=status. If a row's count draft is invalid, or images are still preparing, the bar shows a disabled button with no reason given. While busy, the bar button also keeps `aria-label="Скачать PDF"`. Before this change the settings aside was `position: sticky`, so these messages stayed next to the workspace.
findings.fix: Show the busy label on the bar button (`busy ? 'Подготовка PDF…' : 'Скачать PDF'`, including the aria-label) and render `message`/`draftError` (or a compact status) in the bar. Alternatively, scroll the card into view when either is set.

findings.title: Fixed summary bar has no scroll-padding, so keyboard focus scrolled to the viewport top lands under it
findings.body:
`.minis-summary-bar` is `position: fixed; inset-block-start: 0`, with `min-block-size: 3rem` plus padding. It is visible exactly while the user works in the minis list (rendered at PaperMinisGenerator.tsx:911-915). Nothing sets `scroll-padding-block-start` in src/styles, src/layouts or the component. The only scroll offset is `scroll-margin-block-start` on the header card.

Scenario: a keyboard user Shift+Tabs upward through the mini rows (count inputs, height pickers, menu/delete buttons). The browser scrolls each newly focused control only until it reaches the viewport's top edge, which is under the bar, so the focused control is hidden (WCAG 2.4.11, focus not obscured). The control still works.
findings.fix: While the bar is visible, set `scroll-padding-block-start` on the root, e.g. `html:has(.minis-summary-bar[data-visible='true']) { scroll-padding-block-start: 4rem; }`. Or give the minis rows a matching `scroll-margin-block-start`.

findings.title: IntersectionObserver callback reads only the first queued entry, so a batched out-then-in sequence leaves the bar showing
findings.body:
Observed: the callback destructures `([entry]) => setHeaderOutOfView(!entry.isIntersecting)`. IntersectionObserver delivers every record queued since the last callback, oldest first, so `entries[0]` is the oldest state, not the current one.

What follows (inferred, not reproduced): suppose the main thread is busy, for example while the page decodes images or builds a PDF, and the user quickly scrolls the card out of view and back. The callback can then receive `[not intersecting, intersecting]`. The code sets `headerOutOfView = true`, and the fixed bar stays over the top of a visible card until the next threshold crossing. That breaks the goal's 'appears only while the card is out of view'. The trigger needs a delayed observer callback, so this is unusual.
findings.fix: Use the newest record: `(entries) => setHeaderOutOfView(!entries[entries.length - 1].isIntersecting)`.

findings.title: Popover's default classes are mostly overridden by their only caller and leave a double border
findings.body:
The new `Popover` ships the full shadcn class string: `w-72 p-2.5 bg-popover shadow-md ring-1 ring-foreground/10` plus tw-animate enter/exit/zoom/slide utilities. Its only caller (`PaperMinisGenerator.tsx:786`) overrides the width, padding, background, radius and shadow back to the repo's own popover look (`rounded-lg border border-border bg-surface-elevated p-4 shadow-md`). That is the same set `SelectContent` already uses at `src/components/ui/select.tsx:63`.

What survives the merge:
- `ring-1 ring-foreground/10`, which draws a second 1px box-shadow edge outside the caller's `border border-border`, so the scale popover gets a double outline.
- The animation utilities (`data-entering:animate-in`, `zoom-in-95`, four `slide-in-from-*` variants, `origin-(--trigger-anchor-point)`). No other primitive in `ui/` uses these, so Tailwind emits them only for this popover. They count against the 10 kB Client CSS budget in `.size-limit`.

I don't have the size-check result, so I can't say how close this gets to the budget.
findings.fix: Give `Popover` the base set `SelectContent` already uses (`z-50 overflow-y-auto overscroll-contain rounded-lg border border-border bg-surface-elevated text-text shadow-md outline-hidden`). The caller then only adds width and `p-4`. Drop the ring and, unless the motion is wanted, the tw-animate utilities.

findings.title: 'closes on Escape and an outside click' test repeats contracts already owned by the test.each and focus-return tests
findings.body:
The only edit that turns this test red is breaking Escape dismissal or outside-click dismissal. Both edits already fail other tests:
- The `test.each` at line 102 closes the popover with Escape and with an outside pointerdown, then clicks the trigger again and calls `getByRole('spinbutton')`. If the popover had not closed, that click would toggle it shut and the lookup would throw.
- The focus-return test at line 180 asserts `open: false` after Escape.

So this test has no red-making edit of its own. It is a third copy of the dismissal contract with no named owner.
findings.fix: Delete the test at lines 208–239. Dismissal stays covered by the test.each (both close paths) and the focus-return test (Escape).

findings.title: `minis-scale-popover` class has no rule or selector anywhere
findings.body: `className="minis-scale-popover …"` on the scale popover doesn't match anything. `rg minis-scale-popover` finds only this line: there is no rule in `global.css` and no reference in the component or e2e tests. Every other `minis-*` class added in this change has a rule in `global.css`. This one is a leftover name that suggests styling which doesn't exist.
findings.fix: Remove `minis-scale-popover` from the className.

findings.title: accordion.tsx loses its last consumer but is kept, and its utilities still reach the CSS bundle
findings.body:
This change removes the only import of `Accordion*`, which was the settings sidebar in `PaperMinisGenerator.tsx`. `rg -i accordion` now matches only `src/components/ui/accordion.tsx` itself. The file itself predates this change, but this change is what made it dead.

Tailwind v4 picks up classes from every non-ignored project file, so the accordion's utility classes are still emitted into client CSS. That matters now that this change adds about 3.6 kB to `global.css` under the 10 kB Client CSS limit.
findings.fix: Delete `src/components/ui/accordion.tsx`. A later tool can re-add the primitive if it needs one.

findings.title: `baseStyleSummary` repeats `baseStyleOptions` labels in lowercase
findings.body: `baseStyleSummary` (`складная` / `плоская` / `на пенокартоне`) is exactly `baseStyleOptions[i].label` lowercased, from the table a few lines above. That gives two tables to keep in sync: renaming a style label in one leaves the sticky-bar summary out of step with the select. `toLocaleLowerCase('ru-RU')` gives the same strings for all three labels.
findings.fix: Drop `baseStyleSummary` and build the summary segment from `baseStyleOptions.find(({ value }) => value === settings.baseStyle)?.label.toLocaleLowerCase('ru-RU')`.

findings.title: Summary-bar hidden assertions pass even when the CSS is broken
findings.body: The new test finds the bar's button with getByRole and no includeHidden. Once the bar gets aria-hidden="true", the locator stops matching the button, and toBeHidden counts a missing element as a pass. So the checks here and at line 328 would still pass if the bar stayed visible on screen the whole time, for example if the `.minis-summary-bar[data-visible='true']` selector in global.css were changed to `.minis-summary-bar`. The positive checks after scrolling don't catch that regression either.
findings.fix: For the negative checks, use getByRole with includeHidden: true. First assert the button is in the DOM, then assert it is hidden, so aria-hidden can't stand in for the visual state.

findings.title: Narrow-screen order calls the assembly illustration "слот фигурки", a term that already means something else here
findings.body: The new line reads: "на узком экране складываются в порядке: слот фигурки, поля, footer, PDF-действия". The first block in the card (`.minis-header-mini`, PaperMinisGenerator.tsx:681-687) is a decorative ♙-on-base drawing captioned "как собрать одну фигурку". It is not a slot. In this project "slot" already has two meanings: GLOSSARY.md:22,42 uses it for the standee slot or clip that a flat or foamboard tab goes into, and the component uses `heightSlot`/`HEIGHT_SLOT_ORDER` for the height-size choice. A contributor using DESIGN.md as the layout rule could read "слот фигурки" as the height-slot control or the standee slot and put the wrong element first in the narrow layout. Apart from that word, the stated order matches the DOM and CSS: mini, fields, footer, pdf in a flex column under 52rem.
findings.fix: Name the block by what it is, e.g. "иллюстрация сборки фигурки, поля, footer, PDF-действия".

findings.title: Docs claim the rollback copy survives the prune, but the prune deletes exactly that image
findings.body: ENVIRONMENT.md says that after `docker image prune -f` 'образы остановленных сервисов и локальная копия для отката остаются'. That doesn't match what rebuild.sh does. `do_rebuild` runs `compose pull`, which moves the tag (for example `:latest`) to the new image, so the previous image becomes untagged (dangling). Then `down` + `up -d` replaces the container, so nothing uses the old image any more, and the new `docker image prune -f` at the end of the same run deletes it. The repo has no other rollback mechanism (no retagging; nothing found searching for rollback/откат in scripts/). An operator who trusts this line expects to roll back to the previous image locally after a bad update, and it's gone. Behaviour matches the goal; only the doc claim is wrong.
findings.fix: Drop the 'локальная копия для отката остаются' clause, or say the opposite: the previous image of a re-pulled tag becomes dangling and is deleted, so rolling back needs a fresh pull of a pinned tag.

findings.title: Disk-space alert messages print the free-space value with no unit
findings.body: Both new alert messages write `свободно {{ states('sensor..._disk_free') }}.`, once for rootfs and once for `..._mnt_data_disk_free` in the RAID alert. `states()` returns only the bare number (Glances reports disk_free in GiB), so the push reads like «SSD: занято 87.3%, свободно 12.4.» and the reader can't tell whether 12.4 means GB, GiB or percent. The usage half of the same message has a hard-coded `%`, and every other message in this file writes a unit after `states()` (`°C`).
findings.fix: Add the unit after the template, e.g. `свободно {{ states('...disk_free') }} GiB.`, or append `{{ state_attr('...disk_free','unit_of_measurement') }}`.

findings.title: Dashboard comment still says three groups after a fourth («Место») was added
findings.body: The comment above the Сервер view's cards says 'Три группы вместо одной плитки glance'. This change adds a fourth separator group, «Место», before Диски, Материнка and Вентиляторы, so the comment is now stale.
findings.fix: Change 'Три группы' to 'Четыре группы' (or drop the count).

findings.title: Очистка не гарантирует сохранение образа для отката
findings.body: Добавленная строка обещает сохранить локальную копию для отката. При обновлении сервиса с тегом latest команда pull переносит тег на новый образ, а down удаляет контейнер, удерживавший старый образ. После успешного up старый образ может стать dangling, и добавленный docker image prune -f удалит его. Оператор получает неверную гарантию доступности локального отката.
findings.fix: Убрать гарантию сохранения копии для отката и указать, что предыдущий образ без тега и контейнеров удаляется.

findings.title: ENVIRONMENT.md claims dangling-only prune keeps a local rollback copy; it deletes exactly that image
findings.body: The new line says `docker image prune -f` removes only dangling images and that the local rollback copy stays ("локальная копия для отката остаются"). In `do_rebuild` (scripts/docker/_lib.sh), `pull` moves the tag to the new image, so the previous image loses its tag. Then `down` / `up -d` remove the only container that used it, so it is dangling when rebuild.sh:33 prunes, and the prune deletes it. Issue #8, the spec for this change, says so directly: "Dangling-only does not keep a rollback copy either: after `pull`, the previous `:latest` image loses its tag and is pruned." The worst case is a rebuild where `up -d` fails after `down` has succeeded: the operator reads this doc, expects to start the old image again, and finds it was deleted in the same run. The goal requires that ENVIRONMENT.md says what the scripts do.
findings.fix: Replace the claim with: «образы остановленных сервисов остаются; предыдущая версия пересобранного образа после pull становится dangling и удаляется — локальной копии для отката нет».

findings.title: Disk-space alert messages print the free-space value with no unit
findings.body: Both new messages write `свободно {{ states('sensor.127_0_0_1_rootfs_disk_free') }}.` (and the same for `..._mnt_data_disk_free` at line 78). `states()` returns only the bare number (Glances reports disk_free in GiB), so the push reads e.g. "SSD: занято 87.2%, свободно 12.3." The reader cannot tell whether that is GB or percent. Every other message in this file writes the unit after `states()` (`°C` at lines 92, 106, 123, 137), and the usage half of the same message writes `%`.
findings.fix: Add the unit after the template, e.g. `свободно {{ states('...disk_free') }} GiB.`, or use `{{ states('...disk_free') }} {{ state_attr('...disk_free','unit_of_measurement') }}`.

findings.title: Server-view comment still describes three groups after «Место» became the fourth
findings.body: The comment above the cards says «Три группы вместо одной плитки glance». This change adds a new «Место» separator and grid in front of «Диски», «Материнка» and «Вентиляторы», so the view now has four groups. Before this change it had three (separators at old lines 504/540/566). The change itself made the comment wrong; the impact is limited to the prose.
findings.fix: Change «Три группы» to «Четыре группы» (or drop the count) and mention that «Место» holds disk usage.

findings.title: Документация ошибочно обещает сохранить образ для отката
findings.body: При обновлении плавающего тега, например homeassistant:stable из services/homeassistant/docker-compose.yml:3, прежний образ может остаться без тегов. do_rebuild удаляет старый контейнер через compose down (scripts/docker/_lib.sh:272–274), после чего новый docker image prune -f удалит такой образ, если других ссылок на него нет. Поэтому добавленное обещание сохранить локальную копию для отката неверно: оператор может рассчитывать на образ, которого после rebuild уже нет.
findings.fix: Убрать гарантию сохранения локальной копии для отката и указать, что прежние образы без тегов и ссылок из контейнеров удаляются.

findings.title: ENVIRONMENT.md says rebuild keeps a local rollback copy, but the prune deletes the previous image
findings.body: The new line says: «Удаляются только dangling images; образы остановленных сервисов и локальная копия для отката остаются.» (only dangling images are removed; images of stopped services and the local rollback copy stay). That is not what happens. `do_rebuild` (scripts/docker/_lib.sh:193-195) runs `compose pull`, which moves the tag to the new image and leaves the old image untagged. `down` then removes the container that used the old image, and `up -d` starts a new one from the new image. By the time `docker image prune -f` runs (rebuild.sh:33), the old image is dangling and nothing uses it, so the prune deletes it. That old image is the one you would roll back to. An operator who trusts this sentence and tries to return a service to the old image after a bad update will find it gone and will have to pull an older tag from the registry. This is prose, so it is minor. The part about stopped services is correct, because tagged images are kept.
findings.fix: Replace the rollback claim with something like: «предыдущая версия образа после pull становится dangling и тоже удаляется — откат только через pull конкретного тега» (the previous image becomes dangling after pull and is also deleted; rolling back means pulling a specific tag).

findings.title: Dashboard comment still says «Три группы» after the change adds a fourth group («Место»)
findings.body: The comment above the Сервер view's cards reads «Три группы вместо одной плитки glance: …». This change adds a new «Место» separator and grid right under that comment, ahead of «Диски», «Материнка» and «Вентиляторы». The view now has four groups, so the comment describes the layout as it was before the change. This affects the comment only; it has no runtime effect.
findings.fix: Change «Три группы» to «Четыре группы» (or drop the count).

findings.title: Документация ошибочно обещает сохранить образ для отката
findings.body: Новое утверждение «локальная копия для отката остаётся» неверно при обновлении изменяемого тега, например traefik:latest. В do_rebuild команда pull переносит тег на новый образ, down удаляет старый контейнер, а up создаёт новый. Если других ссылок на прежний образ нет, он становится dangling и удаляется новым docker image prune -f. Оператор получает неверную гарантию доступности локального отката.
findings.fix: Убрать гарантию сохранения копии для отката и указать, что прежний образ без тега и ссылок из контейнеров будет удалён.

findings.title: Doc claims prune keeps the local rollback copy, but the pre-pull image is exactly what `docker image prune -f` removes
findings.body: ENVIRONMENT.md:139 states that after `docker image prune -f` «образы остановленных сервисов и локальная копия для отката остаются». Observed: no service compose file pins an image by digest or uses `build:` (grep finds none), so images are tag-based. do_rebuild runs `compose pull` (the previous image loses its tag and becomes `<none>:<none>`, i.e. dangling), then `down` + `up -d` (the recreated container references the new image, so the old one is unreferenced). `docker image prune -f` removes dangling unreferenced images, so the previous version is deleted on every successful rebuild that changed the image. Follows from this: in the failed-service path the goal mandates (pull ok, down ok, `up -d` fails), the same run deletes the only local copy of the last working image, which is precisely when an operator or agent reading this reference doc would try to re-tag it for rollback. Code behaviour matches the goal; the defect is the false statement in the operator/agent reference.
findings.fix: Drop «и локальная копия для отката» (or state explicitly that the pre-pull image becomes dangling and is removed, so rollback requires re-pulling the old digest).

findings.title: Comment still says «Три группы» after a fourth group («Место») was added above it
findings.body: The comment block at home.yaml:499-502 describes the Сервер view as three groups replacing a glance tile. The change inserts a new «Место» separator+grid directly beneath this comment, so the view now has four groups (Место, Диски, Температуры/…, Вентиляторы) and the comment is stale. Prose only; no runtime effect.
findings.fix: Change «Три группы» to «Четыре группы» (or drop the count).

findings.title: Документация ошибочно обещает сохранить локальный образ для отката
findings.body: После обновления сервиса с тегом latest предыдущий образ теряет тег. В do_rebuild команда compose down удаляет старый контейнер, а compose up создаёт контейнер из нового образа. Если других ссылок на предыдущий образ нет, последующий docker image prune -f удаляет его. Поэтому добавленная гарантия сохранения локальной копии для отката неверна: оператор может рассчитывать на образ, которого после rebuild уже нет.
findings.fix: Уберите обещание сохранения копии для отката. Укажите, что предыдущий образ без тега и ссылок из контейнеров будет удалён.

findings.title: configure_network re-sources config.sh that bootstrap now loads globally
findings.body: This change adds `source "$PROJECT_DIR/scripts/lib/config.sh"` at the top of bootstrap.sh (line 66), right after `.env` and the defaults are loaded. That makes the pre-existing `source "$PROJECT_DIR/scripts/lib/config.sh"` inside configure_network (line 197) a duplicate. config.sh only sets static exports: `USER=${USER:-$(whoami)}` and `TS_HOSTNAME=${HOSTNAME}` give the same values on a second load. None of the steps between the two loads (install_docker, create_directories, set_permissions, create_docker_network) assign any config.sh variable. So the second load changes nothing. Keeping both leaves two places that look like the point where config gets loaded. A later edit that, for example, overrides a NET_* value between the two would be silently reset by the inner load.
findings.fix: Delete the `source "$PROJECT_DIR/scripts/lib/config.sh"` line inside configure_network; the top-level load at line 66 already provides NET_* to it.

findings.title: ENVIRONMENT.md says the local rollback copy survives the prune, but the prune deletes that image
findings.body: The new line in ENVIRONMENT.md says: «Удаляются только dangling images; образы остановленных сервисов и локальная копия для отката остаются.» (only dangling images are removed; the local rollback copy stays). That is not what happens. `do_rebuild` (scripts/docker/_lib.sh) runs `compose pull`, then `down`, then `up -d`. For a floating tag such as `:latest` or `homeassistant:stable`, the pull moves the tag to the new image and leaves the previous image untagged. Once the container is recreated, nothing uses the old image, so it is dangling. The `docker image prune -f` this change adds to rebuild.sh deletes exactly that image. Nothing in the repo tags a pre-rebuild image for rollback, and issue #8 itself notes that dangling-only pruning keeps no rollback copy. Worst case: `up -d` fails after `down` succeeded, and the same run deletes the only local copy of the last working image. CLAUDE.md tells agents to read ENVIRONMENT.md before disk work, so an operator or agent may plan a rollback around an image that no longer exists. The part about stopped services' tagged images is correct.
findings.fix: Replace the rollback clause with the real behaviour, e.g. «образы остановленных сервисов остаются; предыдущая версия пересобранного образа после pull становится dangling и удаляется — откат только через повторный pull старого тега/digest».

findings.title: "real rootfs sensors" gives no entity ids and drops the reason snap_* is wrong
findings.body: The line says "use the real rootfs sensors, never `snap_*` sensors." It names no entity, so the agent has to guess what a "real" rootfs sensor is. The actual ids, `sensor.127_0_0_1_rootfs_disk_usage` and `sensor.living_room_127_0_0_1_rootfs_mnt_data_disk_usage`, are listed only in the `hardware_health.yaml` header. The RAID one does not even follow a plain `rootfs` pattern. The reason the snap sensors are excluded (loop mounts always read 100%) appears only in `ENVIRONMENT.md:140`. That reason is the non-obvious gotcha `CLAUDE.md` should carry. The line also leads with a prohibition instead of naming the right target.
findings.fix: Point to the source of truth and give the reason, for example: "Disk-usage entities are listed in the header of `services/homeassistant/config/packages/hardware_health.yaml`; `snap_*` loop mounts always read 100%."

findings.title: 85%/90% thresholds and the prune behaviour are written in two places each
findings.body: Line 72 copies the alert thresholds ("above 85% ... above 90%") from `hardware_health.yaml:58,72`, and `ENVIRONMENT.md:140` copies them again with the 10-minute duration. The lookup is one file, so these copies go stale as soon as a threshold changes. Inside `CLAUDE.md`, line 61 ("pull + restart, then prune dangling images") and line 71 also describe the same prune behaviour twice. Every copy is one more place to update when the behaviour changes.
findings.fix: Have line 72 point to `hardware_health.yaml` for thresholds and durations, and keep line 71 only for what line 61 cannot show (the prune also runs after a failed service, dangling images only).

findings.title: ENVIRONMENT.md hard-codes SystemMaxUse=1G while CLAUDE.md names config.sh as the source
findings.body: `ENVIRONMENT.md` says bootstrap writes "`SystemMaxUse=1G`". `CLAUDE.md:70` correctly says the value is `JOURNALD_SYSTEM_MAX_USE` in `scripts/lib/config.sh`. If `config.sh` changes, `ENVIRONMENT.md` will state a size the drop-in no longer has, and the two documents will disagree.
findings.fix: Write «`SystemMaxUse=$JOURNALD_SYSTEM_MAX_USE` (см. `scripts/lib/config.sh`, сейчас 1G)» or drop the literal value.

findings.title: Trigger "Home Assistant hardware alerts" is wider than the block's content
findings.body: The trigger is `<important if="you are working with disk space, journald, or Home Assistant hardware alerts">`. The block only covers the disk-space alerts. `hardware_health.yaml` also holds CPU, fan and RAID-temperature alerts, so the block also loads for work on those, where none of its content applies. The match is also weaker for the case the block is actually about.
findings.fix: Narrow the branch to "Home Assistant disk-space alerts".

findings.title: The reviewed range doesn't contain PRD-3672: offerAccepted has no `section`, and the diff reverts PRD-3663/3666 CTA naming
findings.body:
HEAD 6fbfb05e2f ("fix: remove eager partner preview post") is not a descendant of base 4bdce06aa7. Its merge-base with the base is the older 79810ee497 (#6709). So the two-dot range touches about 1090 files (+45913/−89634), not the scope's 10 files (+114/−14), and mostly undoes work merged after #6709, including #6813.

At HEAD:
- `press()` builds `accepted = { offerKey, company?, amazonStoreKey? }` and calls `track('offerAccepted', accepted, …)` with no `section`. amazon-checkup-offer.tsx ~line 508 is the same.
- `CTA_SECTIONS`, `CtaSection`, `ctaAttrs` and `BOOK_CALL_PLACEMENTS` are deleted from site.ts (the base has them at line 148). Every `data-cta`/`data-cta-section` attribute is stripped from both offer pages, and `ticket` cannot be a CtaSection.
- The offer tests still expect an `offerAccepted` payload without `section`.
- The docs don't describe the property.

Every "Correct only if" criterion fails, and the "406 tests green / typecheck 0" evidence cannot describe this tree. Shipping this range would remove CTA click naming instead of adding `offerAccepted.section`.
findings.fix: Point the review and PR at the real `prd-3672-offer-page-name` tip, rebased on main (4bdce06aa7 or later). Produce the diff from the true merge base (three-dot) and re-run tests and typecheck there.

findings.title: The reviewed HEAD doesn't send offerAccepted.section
findings.body: Clicking any button on a valid offer sends offerAccepted without `section`; amazon-checkup-offer.tsx:504–508 does the same. PostHog therefore cannot tell ticket, hero and close-band apart, which contradicts PRD-3672's goal. The reviewer notes this behavior already exists at the common ancestor, so it is not a regression. HEAD 6fbfb05e2f contains partner-preview changes rather than the PRD-3672 implementation.
findings.fix: Review a HEAD that contains PRD-3672: mark the button sections and pass data-cta-section into offerAccepted on both pages.

findings.title: The checkout doesn't contain the PRD-3672 change: HEAD sends offerAccepted without `section`, and the scope's diff range spans 1090 unrelated files
findings.body:
The reviewed state doesn't match the scope. The checkout HEAD is `6fbfb05e2f` ("fix: remove eager partner preview post"). It sits on a partner-preview branch whose merge-base with the scope's base `4bdce06aa7` is `79810ee497` (#6709). The base isn't an ancestor of HEAD (`git merge-base --is-ancestor` fails).

As a result, `git diff 4bdce06aa7..6fbfb05e2f` reports 1090 files changed (+45913/−89634), not the 10 files and +114/−14 the scope describes. Within `console/components/marketing` alone, it deletes `pages/for-experts.tsx` (1171 lines) and rewrites `customer-stories.tsx`.

At HEAD, none of the goal's correctness conditions hold:
- `press()` in `amazon-scorecard-offer.tsx:491-495` builds `accepted = { offerKey, company?, amazonStoreKey? }` with no `section`. `amazon-checkup-offer.tsx:~508` is the same.
- `site.ts` has no `CTA_SECTIONS`, `CtaSection` or `ctaAttrs` at all. They exist at base (`site.ts:148-151` from #6813) and so are removed by the HEAD side of the range. `ticket` therefore isn't a valid section.
- The test at `amazon-scorecard-offer.test.ts:738` still expects `['offerAccepted', { offerKey: 'gift-riverbend', amazonStoreKey: 'cafe-ole' }, …]` with no `section`.

If this branch shipped as checked out, it would revert PRD-3663/3666's CTA naming and would not deliver PRD-3672. Whatever produced the "406 tests green" evidence was not this checkout's PRD-3672 state.
findings.fix: Check out the actual `prd-3672-offer-page-name` head, built on `4bdce06aa7`, and re-run the review against it. Do not ship from `6fbfb05e2f`.

findings.title: Удалена отправка ctaClicked с публичных страниц
findings.body: В указанном диапазоне удалён ctaClickHandler, а из обеих страниц оффера удалены data-cta и data-cta-section. После сборки нажатия больше не отправляют ctaClicked: autocapture также выключен. Это нарушает существующий контракт internal-dev-doc/posthog-session-replay.md:23 в базовом коммите 4bdce06 и требование goal.md сохранить согласованность ctaClicked. Регрессия введена рассматриваемым diff.
findings.fix: Сохранить обработчик ctaClicked и атрибуты кнопок; расширить CTA_SECTIONS значением ticket вместо удаления механизма.

findings.title: offerAccepted still doesn't distinguish the three buttons
findings.body: On a valid offer, `accepted` holds only offerKey plus optional company and amazonStoreKey. Ticket, store-block and closing-band clicks send identical payloads without `section`; amazon-checkup-offer.tsx:504–508 is the same. This existed before the change but still violates PRD-3672.
findings.fix: On both pages, give the buttons sections ticket, hero and close-band, and put the clicked button's data-cta-section into accepted.section after the preview and offer-state checks.

findings.title: The reviewed range doesn't contain the PRD-3672 change; as produced, the diff reverts the PRD-3663 CTA naming
findings.body:
The scope command `git diff 4bdce06aa7..6fbfb05e2f` doesn't produce the described 10-file, +114/−14 change. HEAD 6fbfb05e2f ('fix: remove eager partner preview post') is not a descendant of the base. Its merge-base with 4bdce06aa7 is 79810ee497 (#6709), which is older than the base. So the two-dot diff shows 1090 files, +45913/−89634, and mostly undoes work merged after #6709, including #6813 (PRD-3663/3666, 'Name every call-to-action click').

In the scoped files, the diff:
- deletes `CTA_NAMES`, `CTA_SECTIONS`, `CtaSection`, `ctaAttrs` and `BOOK_CALL_PLACEMENTS` from `console/components/marketing/site.ts`
- strips every `data-cta`/`data-cta-section` attribute from the gift ticket, store block and blocked buttons on both offer pages
- drops `ctaName` from the closing band's `primary`
- removes 373 lines from `marketing-render.test.ts`

At HEAD, `press()` builds `accepted = { offerKey, company?, amazonStoreKey? }` and sends it as `offerAccepted` with no `section`. The checkup page is the same at line ~508. No `ticket` entry exists anywhere, because `CTA_SECTIONS` itself is gone.

Every 'Correct only if' criterion fails on the state under review:
- the gift ticket doesn't send `section: 'ticket'`
- `ticket` is not a `CtaSection`
- `ctaClicked` has no section attributes to be consistent with

The 'Already verified on HEAD' results (406 tests, typecheck) can't describe the intended change, since it isn't in this tree. If this range were shipped as the PR, it would remove the CTA click naming from the public pages rather than add `offerAccepted.section`. Rerun the review against the actual `prd-3672-offer-page-name` tip with its true merge-base.
findings.fix: Point the review at the real `prd-3672-offer-page-name` head, and produce the diff with `git diff $(git merge-base origin/main <head>)..<head>` (or three-dot) instead of the current two-dot range.

findings.title: Tests pin offerAccepted without the required section
findings.body: This gap predates the change, and PRD-3672 leaves it open. Here and in amazon-checkup-offer.test.ts:476, an exact match expects a payload without `section`, and only the first button is exercised. The tests therefore accept indistinguishable offerAccepted events for the ticket, store-block and closing-band clicks, and would fail if the required section were added.
findings.fix: On both pages, test clicks on all three buttons with literal expected sections ticket, hero and close-band.

findings.title: The publish step sends the agent to a different host than the Publishing section
findings.body: The change adds "publish them at offers.membrane.agency as above". But the Publishing section (lines 69–82) specifies membrane.agency/p/<key> and the `pages:publish` command, and scripts/pages-publish.ts publishes the static artifact through the platform. An agent following step 1 cannot reach the required address with the given command.
findings.fix: Drop the offers.membrane.agency requirement and refer to the existing Publishing section.

findings.title: Удалён обработчик, который отправлял ctaClicked
findings.body: В заданном диапазоне удалены ctaClickHandler и его подписки, а autocapture остаётся выключенным. После сборки клик по Start на любой offer-странице больше не отправляет ctaClicked вообще. Это новая регрессия: scope разрешает изменить section у этих событий, но требует сохранить сами события. Удаление проверок CTA в marketing-render.test.ts позволяет указанным проверкам оставаться зелёными при таком поведении.
findings.fix: Восстановить обработчик ctaClicked, CTA-атрибуты и их проверки; добавить ticket в разрешённые секции.

findings.title: Both pages send offerAccepted without section
findings.body: On a valid offer the handler builds only offerKey, company and amazonStoreKey; amazon-checkup-offer.tsx:504–508 is the same. Ticket, hero and close-band clicks produce indistinguishable events, contrary to PRD-3672. The missing section already existed at the range's base, and the existing tests explicitly expect a payload without section.
findings.fix: On both pages, set data-cta-section to ticket, hero and close-band and pass the clicked button's value into offerAccepted.section.

findings.title: The auxclick handler accepts right-button clicks
findings.body: This defect predates the change and affects both offer pages: `press` listens to auxclick but never checks event.button. In browsers that fire auxclick for the right button, right-clicking Start on a valid offer saves setup and sends offerAccepted, even though the visitor only opened the context menu. The test helper fires auxclick only with button: 1, so it cannot catch this.
findings.fix: In both handlers, ignore auxclick when event.button !== 1.

findings.title: Reviewed range has no PRD-3672 change: offerAccepted has no `section` at HEAD, and the diff would revert PRD-3663/3666
findings.body:
The scope's command (`git diff 4bdce06aa7..6fbfb05e2f`) does not produce the change it describes. HEAD 6fbfb05e2f ('fix: remove eager partner preview post') is a partner-preview branch. It forked from 79810ee497 (#6709), which is older than the base 4bdce06aa7 (PRD-3663/3666, #6813). So the range touches 1090 files (+45,913/−89,634), not the stated 10 files (+114/−14). It is mostly main's later work in reverse.

What this means at HEAD:
- `press()` in amazon-scorecard-offer.tsx:486-495 still sends `offerAccepted` with only `offerKey`, `company` and `amazonStoreKey`. It reads no `data-cta-section`. The checkup page is the same (line 508).
- `console/components/marketing/site.ts` has no `CTA_SECTIONS` and no `ctaAttrs`. The base has them at lines 148-151; the range deletes them along with every `data-cta` / `data-cta-section` attribute on the offer pages.
- Neither offer test file contains any section or `ticket` assertion. The two docs (`internal-dev-doc/posthog-session-replay.md`, `.claude/skills/offer-pages/SKILL.md`) never mention `offerAccepted`.
- No ref and no commit in the object store adds a `ticket` CTA section. `git log --all -S"'ticket'" -- site.ts` finds nothing, and `git for-each-ref` is empty.

None of the goal's 'Correct only if' items can hold on this state. The '406 tests green on HEAD' cannot cover `offerAccepted.section`. If this range were shipped as the PR, it would undo PRD-3663/3666's CTA naming instead of extending it.
findings.fix: Point the scope at the real `prd-3672-offer-page-name` head, or rebase the branch onto 4bdce06aa7 so the range holds only the ~10-file change, then re-run the review and tests on that state.

findings.title: Удалены проверки CTA, которые задача требует сохранить
findings.body: В указанном диапазоне удалены тесты `marks every tracked marketing interaction as a CTA` и проверки допустимых CTA-секций. Конкретная правка, которая делала первый тест красным: удалить `data-cta` у ссылки с `data-offer-go`. Именно это диапазон делает на обеих offer-страницах, одновременно удаляя обработчик `ctaClicked` из `document.tsx`. Теперь клики вообще не отправляют `ctaClicked`, хотя scope требует сохранить событие с секциями `ticket` и `hero`. Оставшаяся проверка совпадения сборки с компонентами допускает эту потерю после обновления сгенерированных страниц.
findings.fix: Восстановить отслеживание CTA и удалённые проверки; добавить `ticket` в допустимые секции и закрепить секции кнопок `ticket`, `hero`, `close-band`.

findings.title: The reviewed range doesn't contain PRD-3672 and would revert main's offer-pages skill and docs
findings.body:
The scope command `git diff 4bdce06aa7..6fbfb05e2f` doesn't show the change the scope describes. HEAD `6fbfb05e2f` is a detached commit on an unrelated branch: 4 partner-preview commits on top of `79810ee497`. Base `4bdce06aa7` (#6813, PRD-3663/3666) is 88 commits ahead of that merge base on main.

If this diff shipped as produced, it would revert main's agent-facing prose:
- The `offer-pages` skill loses its "Where an offer goes today" section and "The funnel and its events" table.
- Its description goes back to publishing at membrane.agency/p/<key>, and the `offerViewed`/`offerAccepted` triggers disappear.
- The legacy-host text goes back to the present tense.
- `internal-dev-doc/posthog-session-replay.md` loses 27 lines.

An agent asked where offer traffic lands would be sent to the kit page or the legacy host rather than `/scorecard/amazon/offer`, and would find no `offerAccepted` property list. None of the "Correct only if" items can be checked against this state.
findings.fix: Re-run the review against the actual `prd-3672-offer-page-name` branch head and its merge base with main, e.g. `git diff $(git merge-base origin/main <branch>)...<branch>`. Ship nothing from this range.

findings.title: offerAccepted still sends no `section`, and `ticket` is not a CtaSection: none of PRD-3672's criteria hold at HEAD
findings.body:
At HEAD (6fbfb05e2f), `press()` in amazon-scorecard-offer.tsx:485-496 builds `accepted = { offerKey, company?, amazonStoreKey? }`. amazon-checkup-offer.tsx:504-508 does the same. Neither reads the pressed button's `data-cta-section`. `rg CTA_SECTIONS|ctaAttrs|data-cta-section console/components/marketing` finds nothing, and neither posthog-session-replay.md nor .claude/skills/offer-pages/SKILL.md mentions `offerAccepted`.

The review range 4bdce06aa7..6fbfb05e2f is not the 10-file PRD-3672 change described in the scope. It is 1090 files (+45913/-89634) from an unrelated partner-preview branch. Within that range it goes the opposite way: it removes `export const CTA_SECTIONS`, `CtaSection` and `ctaAttrs` from console/components/marketing/site.ts, and removes the existing `data-cta-section='body'` attributes from the offer-page start buttons.

As a result, ticket, store-block and close-band acceptances are indistinguishable in PostHog, and `ctaClicked` attribution on these buttons is lost. None of PRD-3672's acceptance criteria hold, and the test and typecheck evidence cannot cover the intended change.
findings.fix: Point the review at the commit or branch that actually implements PRD-3672. Then check that site.ts exports CTA_SECTIONS with `ticket`, that the ticket and store buttons on both offer pages carry `ctaAttrs('accept-offer', 'ticket'|'hero')`, and that `press()` sets `accepted.section` from `go.getAttribute('data-cta-section')`.

findings.title: В проверяемой ревизии отсутствует offerAccepted.section
findings.body: При действующем предложении нажатие любой Start-кнопки отправляет offerAccepted без section. Обработчик Checkup в amazon-checkup-offer.tsx:504–508 делает то же самое. Поэтому PostHog не различает ticket, hero и close-band, что прямо противоречит цели PRD-3672. Это прежнее поведение, а не внесённая регрессия: указанный HEAD 6fbfb05 содержит изменения предпросмотра партнёра, а заявленная реализация отсутствует.
findings.fix: Предоставить ревизию с реализацией PRD-3672 либо добавить section из data-cta-section в оба обработчика и соответствующие атрибуты кнопок.

findings.title: Reviewed HEAD does not contain the PRD-3672 change: offerAccepted still sends no `section`
findings.body:
The checkout HEAD (6fbfb05e2f, detached) is the tip of an unrelated partner-preview branch: its four commits are bbc3780d79 through 6fbfb05e2f. It forked from 79810ee497, which is older than the stated base 4bdce06aa7, so the base is not an ancestor of HEAD. `git log --all | grep 3672` finds no PRD-3672 commit and no `prd-3672-offer-page-name` branch.

At HEAD, `press()` in amazon-scorecard-offer.tsx:486-496 and amazon-checkup-offer.tsx:499-509 builds `accepted = { offerKey, company?, amazonStoreKey? }` and never reads `data-cta-section`. The gift ticket (scorecard ~:194, checkup ~:195) and the store block (~:246) carry no `data-cta`/`data-cta-section` attributes at all. `CTA_SECTIONS`/`ctaAttrs` do not exist in site.ts, and there is no `ticket` value. The scorecard test at amazon-scorecard-offer.test.ts:738 still expects `['offerAccepted', { offerKey, amazonStoreKey }, ...]` with no section.

Every 'correct only if' criterion in the goal (ticket→`ticket`, store→`hero`, closing band→`close-band`, `ticket` a valid CtaSection, docs matching) fails on this state. The '406 tests green / typecheck exit 0' evidence cannot cover the described change, because that change is not in this tree.
findings.fix: Check out the actual prd-3672-offer-page-name branch (rebased on 4bdce06aa7 or later) and re-run the review and its checks against it.

findings.title: The base..HEAD range rolls back #6813's CTA naming (CTA_NAMES, CTA_SECTIONS, ctaAttrs, data-cta attributes) and the public-pages analytics docs
findings.body:
HEAD forked before the base commit 4bdce06aa7 (PRD-3663/3666 #6813, 'Name every call-to-action click'). So the scoped diff `git diff 4bdce06aa7..6fbfb05e2f` deletes, among much else (hundreds of files, including .contracts/reasons, for-experts.tsx and stepper.tsx):
- `BOOK_CALL_PLACEMENTS`, `CTA_NAMES`, `CTA_SECTIONS` and `ctaAttrs` from site.ts:121-153
- the `section` parameter of `contactEmailHtml`
- every `data-cta`/`data-cta-section` on the offer pages' blocked-notice, gift-ticket and store-block links, plus the `ctaName` fields on the close-band primaries (amazon-checkup-offer.tsx:837,843; amazon-scorecard-offer.tsx:832)
- the 'Public pages' and 'Scroll depth' sections of internal-dev-doc/posthog-session-replay.md, which document `ctaClicked {cta, section, page, href}` and `offerAccepted`

If this range ships as a patch (cherry-pick or squash of the diff), `ctaClicked` loses its names and sections on these pages, and the docs agents read for the PostHog funnel lose the event list. Merging HEAD's own commits through a normal 3-way merge would not cause this. The problem is that the range under review is not the intended change.
findings.fix: Rebase the PRD-3672 branch onto main at or after 4bdce06aa7, then regenerate the diff so it holds only the ~10 intended files.

findings.title: The range removes the ctaClicked click/auxclick handler from the public pages
findings.body:
The range deletes `ctaClickHandler` and its click/auxclick listeners from POSTHOG_SCRIPT, which sit at document.tsx:100–102 in base 4bdce06. It also strips the CTA markup from both offer pages and the closed lists from site.ts.

Autocapture is set to `false`, so pressing Start no longer sends `ctaClicked` at all. This is a regression the range introduces, and it breaks the scope's requirement that `ctaClicked` keep working with the ticket/hero sections.
findings.fix: Restore the ctaClicked handler, the CTA markup and the types. Add `ticket` to CTA_SECTIONS and give the buttons the required sections (ticket, hero, close-band).

findings.title: offerAccepted по-прежнему не содержит section на обеих страницах
findings.body: При действующем предложении вне preview обработчик формирует accepted только из offerKey, company и amazonStoreKey. Кнопки билета, магазина и нижнего блока отправляют одинаковый набор свойств; определить нажатую кнопку невозможно. То же происходит в amazon-checkup-offer.tsx:504–508. Отсутствие section существовало до изменения, но осталось неисправленным вопреки явному контракту goal.md: ticket, hero и close-band для соответствующих кнопок.
findings.fix: На обеих страницах добавить в accepted поле section из data-cta-section нажатой кнопки и обеспечить значения ticket, hero и close-band в разметке.

findings.title: The reviewed range has no PRD-3672 change; it reverts the CTA instrumentation from #6813 and much of main
findings.body:
The scope command is `git diff 4bdce06aa7..6fbfb05e2f`, but 4bdce06aa7 (PRD-3663/3666, #6813) is not an ancestor of HEAD. The merge-base is 79810ee497. HEAD is a detached side line of four partner-preview commits, and `git log 6fbfb05e2f..4bdce06aa7` lists 88 main commits that HEAD lacks.

The diff therefore changes about 1090 files (+45913/−89634), not the 10 files (+114/−14) the scope describes. Restricted to the marketing paths it is 44 files, +623/−4143.

What this range deletes:
- From `site.ts`: `CTA_NAMES`, `CTA_SECTIONS`, `CtaSection`, `ctaAttrs` and `BOOK_CALL_PLACEMENTS`, plus the `section` parameter and the `data-cta`/`data-cta-section` attributes of `contactEmailHtml`. No `'ticket'` entry exists anywhere.
- From both offer pages: every `data-cta`/`data-cta-section` attribute and the close-band `ctaName` fields.
- Whole pages and components such as `for-experts.tsx` (−1171) and stepper.tsx.
- Tests: `job.top-cta.test.ts`, `jobs.test.ts`, most of `marketing-render.test.ts` and `document.test.ts`. The offer-test regexes are loosened so they no longer assert CTA attributes.
- From `internal-dev-doc/posthog-session-replay.md`: the Public pages and Scroll depth sections, which document `ctaClicked {cta, section, page, href}`, `offerAccepted` and others. SKILL.md also gets unrelated churn.

If the range ships as a patch (squash or cherry-pick), `ctaClicked` names and sections disappear from production pages and the PRD-3672 property is still missing. The supplied "406 tests green / typecheck 0" evidence cannot belong to this tree: tests it relies on, such as EXPECTED_CTA_SECTIONS, exist only at the base.
findings.fix: Point the review and the PR at the actual `prd-3672-offer-page-name` commit, rebased onto 4bdce06aa7 or a later main, and regenerate the diff so it holds only the ~10 intended files. Do not ship 6fbfb05e2f against this base.

findings.title: The tests that would catch lost CTA markup are deleted
findings.body:
The range deletes `marks every tracked marketing interaction as a CTA` and `has its approved CTA identity`, which check `data-cta`/`data-cta-section` and the table of button identities. Nothing replaces them.

In the same diff, both offer pages lose their CTA attributes and document.tsx loses the ctaClicked handler. The first deleted test would have flagged `[data-offer-go]` buttons that have no CTA name. The remaining check only compares the HTML with the components, so it accepts markup that is broken consistently in both. That is lost coverage of a concrete regression, and it contradicts the requirement to keep `ctaClicked` intact.
findings.fix: Restore the CTA markup tests, update the expected sections to ticket, hero and close-band, and keep a test that ctaClicked is sent on press.

findings.title: The reviewed range is inverted and HEAD has none of PRD-3672: `offerAccepted` still has no `section` and `ticket` is not in `CTA_SECTIONS`
findings.body:
What I observed: `git diff 4bdce06aa7..6fbfb05e2f`, the command named in scope.md, touches 1090 files (+45913 / −89634), not the 10 files the scope describes. Their merge-base is 79810ee497. Base 4bdce06aa7 is main at PRD-3663/3666 (#6813, 88 commits past the merge-base). HEAD 6fbfb05e2f is a detached side line of 4 'partner preview' commits. No commit reachable from any ref mentions PRD-3672 for this work.

At HEAD:
- `amazon-scorecard-offer.tsx:491` builds `var accepted = { offerKey: key }` with only `company` and `amazonStoreKey` added. No `data-cta-section` is read and no `section` is sent. `amazon-checkup-offer.tsx:504` is the same.
- `console/components/marketing/` has no `CTA_SECTIONS`, `CtaSection` or `ctaAttrs`. The range diff deletes them from `site.ts`, along with `CTA_NAMES`, `BOOK_CALL_PLACEMENTS` and the `data-cta` attributes in `contactEmailHtml`.
- Neither `.claude/skills/offer-pages/SKILL.md` nor `internal-dev-doc/posthog-session-replay.md` mentions `offerAccepted`.

What follows from that: none of the goal's 'correct only if' items holds on the reviewed state. No button sends `ticket` / `hero` / `close-band`, `ticket` is not a valid `CtaSection`, and the docs don't describe the event. The 'Already verified on HEAD' results (406 tests, typecheck) can't cover PRD-3672 code, because this tree has none. Shipping this range as a PR would not add the feature. It would undo 88 commits of main, including PRD-3663's CTA naming, and the checks would still look green.
findings.fix: Point the review at the real `prd-3672-offer-page-name` commit, with base = its merge-base with main (e.g. `git diff $(git merge-base main <branch>)..<branch>`). Re-run the tests and typecheck on that commit before deciding whether it ships.

findings.title: Удалён обработчик отправки ctaClicked
findings.body: Указанный диапазон удаляет из POSTHOG_SCRIPT обработчики click и auxclick для ctaClicked. При autocapture:false нажатие CTA больше не отправляет это событие. Одновременно из обеих offer-страниц удалены data-cta и data-cta-section. Это введённая диапазоном регрессия: требование сохранить ctaClicked не выполнено.
findings.fix: Восстановить обработчики и CTA-атрибуты, назначив кнопкам секции ticket, hero и close-band.

findings.title: offerAccepted по-прежнему отправляется без section
findings.body: В проверенном HEAD объект accepted содержит только offerKey и необязательные company и amazonStoreKey. Нажатия ticket, hero и close-band дают неразличимые события. В amazon-checkup-offer.tsx:504–508 действует тот же код. Отсутствие section существовало и в базе; указанный диапазон не реализует основное требование PRD-3672. Существующие тесты также ожидают payload без section.
findings.fix: На обеих страницах добавить в accepted поле section из нажатого элемента и обеспечить предусмотренные значения атрибутов.

findings.title: The auxclick handler accepts right-clicks and records a false offerAccepted
findings.body:
This exists on both offer pages and was not introduced by the change. `press` listens to `auxclick` without checking `event.button`.

A right-click on a valid offer's button passes the state check, saves setup and sends `offerAccepted`, even though the visitor only opened a context menu. That adds false acceptances to the funnel.
findings.fix: Before saving setup and sending the event, ignore an auxclick whose `event.button !== 1`.

findings.title: Reviewed HEAD is a stale partner-preview branch; the scoped diff reverts 88 main commits including PRD-3663 CTA naming
findings.body: HEAD 6fbfb05e2f is not the PRD-3672 branch. Its four commits since the merge-base are 'Lock partner preview note contract', 'fix: explain partner profile preview state', 'Lock partner preview readiness handshake' and 'fix: remove eager partner preview post'. Its merge-base with the base 4bdce06aa7 is 79810ee497, and `git log 6fbfb05e2f..4bdce06aa7` lists 88 commits that HEAD does not have. The scope's command, `git diff 4bdce06aa7..6fbfb05e2f`, therefore produces 1090 files changed, +45913/−89634, not the 10 files / +114/−14 that scope.md describes. Shipping this tree on top of the base would undo all 88 commits. Among them is PRD-3663 (#6813), which this feature depends on. In site.ts it deletes `CTA_NAMES`, `CTA_SECTIONS`, `CtaSection` and `ctaAttrs`, plus `BOOK_CALL_PLACEMENTS`. In amazon-scorecard-offer.tsx and amazon-checkup-offer.tsx it strips every `data-cta`/`data-cta-section` attribute. It deletes for-experts.tsx (−1171), stepper.tsx, job.top-cta.test.ts and jobs.test.ts. It removes most of marketing-render.test.ts (−373) and document.test.ts (−426). In the offer tests, `target="_top"[^>]*>` becomes `target="_top">`, which drops the CTA attribute assertions. The '406 tests green / typecheck 0' evidence in goal.md cannot belong to this tree, because the tests it names (e.g. EXPECTED_CTA_SECTIONS in marketing-render.test.ts) exist only at the base.
findings.fix: Re-point the review and PR at the actual prd-3672-offer-page-name branch, rebased on main (it should contain 4bdce06aa7), and regenerate the diff. Do not ship 6fbfb05e2f against this base.

findings.title: offerAccepted carries no `section`, and no `ticket` CtaSection exists — none of the goal's correctness criteria hold at HEAD
findings.body: In `press()` at HEAD, the payload is `{ offerKey, company?, amazonStoreKey? }` (lines 489–495; amazon-checkup-offer.tsx ~508 is the same). It never reads the pressed button's `data-cta-section`. The gift ticket, store block and closing band therefore all send identical `offerAccepted` events, so PRD-3672 (tell which Start button was pressed) is not delivered. The buttons themselves have no `data-cta-section` at HEAD: GiftTicket renders `<a className='so-gift-go' data-offer-go='' href='#start' target='_top'>`. `CTA_SECTIONS` doesn't exist anywhere in console/components/marketing at HEAD (`git grep` finds nothing), so `ticket` is not a valid CtaSection. Neither `internal-dev-doc/posthog-session-replay.md` nor `.claude/skills/offer-pages/SKILL.md` mentions `offerAccepted` at HEAD, so the doc criterion isn't met either.
findings.fix: Review the commit that actually implements PRD-3672: add `ticket` to CTA_SECTIONS, add `ctaAttrs('accept-offer', 'ticket'|'hero')` on the ticket and store buttons, and set `accepted.section = go.getAttribute('data-cta-section')` in `press()` on both pages.

findings.title: Удалены проверки, которые обнаруживают потерю CTA-разметки
findings.body: В фактическом диапазоне из scope.md удалены тесты `marks every tracked marketing interaction as a CTA` и `has its approved CTA identity`. Одновременно обе offer-страницы теряют `data-cta` и `data-cta-section`; сохранённый первый тест обнаружил бы кнопки `[data-offer-go]` без CTA-имени. Замены этим проверкам в console нет, а оставшаяся проверка совпадения HTML с компонентами принимает согласованно сломанную разметку. Это введённая диапазоном потеря защиты контракта: goal.md требует сохранить согласованность `ctaClicked`, а не удалить её проверку.
findings.fix: Вернуть проверки CTA-разметки и обновить ожидаемые секции согласно задаче: ticket, hero и close-band.

findings.title: Проверка повтора принимает ошибки, которые не являются MembraneError
findings.body: По контракту повтор допустим только для MembraneError с ключом `rate_limit_exceeded`. Проверка распознаёт любой объект с `data.key === 'rate_limit_exceeded'` и не проверяет признак MembraneError (в тестовом примере это `isMembraneError: true`, linear-graphql.test.ts:601). Если `client.run` выбросит ошибку другого происхождения с таким ключом, `connectionGraphql` повторит запрос до двух раз (всего до трёх попыток) вместо немедленного возврата исходной ошибки. Для GraphQL mutations повторный вызов может повторить операцию, если первый запрос уже имел побочный эффект.
findings.fix: Проверять признак MembraneError вместе с `data.key` и повторять запрос только при совпадении обоих условий.

findings.title: Проверка повтора принимает ошибки, которые не являются MembraneError
findings.body: По условию задачи повтор допустим только для MembraneError с ключом rate_limit_exceeded. Схема проверяет только data.key: например, обычная ошибка с таким полем тоже вызовет до трёх попыток вместо немедленного возврата. Это нарушает контракт connectionGraphql и может повторить мутацию. В тестовом примере MembraneError имеет признак isMembraneError: true (linear-graphql.test.ts:601), но схема его не проверяет.
findings.fix: Проверять признак MembraneError вместе с data.key перед повтором.

findings.title: Тест не проверяет отказ с ключом rate limit вне MembraneError
findings.body: Контракт допускает повтор только для MembraneError с ключом `rate_limit_exceeded`. Тест другого типа ошибки использует другой ключ, поэтому не обнаруживает, что `connectionGraphql` повторяет вызов и для обычной ошибки с `data.key === 'rate_limit_exceeded'`. В этом случае ошибка должна возвращаться без ожидания и повторного вызова.
findings.fix: Добавить тест с обычной ошибкой с этим ключом и проверить один вызов, отсутствие ожидания и возврат исходной ошибки.

findings.title: Проверка rate limit не отличает MembraneError от других ошибок
findings.body: Если `client.run` выбросит ошибку другого происхождения с полем `data.key: 'rate_limit_exceeded'`, проверка примет её за отказ платформы. `connectionGraphql` повторит запрос до двух раз вместо немедленного возврата исходной ошибки, хотя контракт разрешает повтор только для MembraneError. Это также относится к GraphQL mutations.
findings.fix: Проверять признак MembraneError вместе с ключом ошибки.

findings.title: Тест не проверяет отказ с ключом rate limit вне MembraneError
findings.body: Отрицательный тест для ошибки другого типа использует другой ключ ошибки. Поэтому он проходит, хотя `connectionGraphql` повторяет вызов для любого объекта с `data.key === 'rate_limit_exceeded'`, включая ошибку без признака MembraneError. По контракту такая ошибка должна сразу возвращаться вызывающему коду без ожидания и повторного вызова; в случае mutation код вместо этого может повторно выполнить запрос.
findings.fix: Добавить случай с обычной ошибкой с ключом `rate_limit_exceeded` без признака MembraneError и проверять один вызов, отсутствие ожидания и возврат исходной ошибки.

findings.title: Нет подтверждения, что тест ограничения параллелизма падает на прежней реализации
findings.body: Тест должен ловить возврат к неограниченному чтению 120 threads: с Promise.all maxInFlight будет 120, а не 8. Но в переданных материалах нет запуска, показывающего, что тест действительно падает на прежней реализации. Вопрос снимется, если автор приложит результат запуска на прежнем коде, где тест падает именно из-за превышения лимита.

findings.title: Rate-limit retry matches any error whose data.key is rate_limit_exceeded, not only a MembraneError
findings.body: The goal says `connectionGraphql` should retry only a MembraneError with `error.data.key === 'rate_limit_exceeded'`, and should rethrow every other error unchanged.
